jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About Ryft

Ryft is a regulated payment facilitator and authorised payment institution building the infrastructure layer for modern commerce platforms.  We enable marketplaces, SaaS platforms and multi-party ecosystems to embed and monetise payments natively. Our technology handles onboarding, compliance, orchestration, split payments and revenue sharing, allowing our partners to focus on growth while we manage complexity.

We are now entering the next phase of scale, expanding into new verticals and building a category-defining embedded payments platform.

About the Job

Are you a senior backend engineer who wants to own the systems that move real money, on a platform still young enough to shape?

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join one of our core payments squads. You'll work in C#/.NET on AWS, building the event-driven services behind everything Ryft does: taking payments, splitting them between marketplaces and their sellers, moving money out, and keeping all of it correct under load and under regulation.

This is a hands-on senior engineering role. You'll be in the conversation from design through to production, shaping the architecture, writing the code, reviewing your squad's, and owning what you ship once it's live. Our platform is a few years old, not a few decades: there's genuine greenfield alongside services you'll inherit and improve, and the decisions you make this year will still be load-bearing in three.

What You'll Work On

Payment integrations: building and extending our integrations with acquirers, processors, and alternative payment methods. Each one is a different set of rules, webhooks, and failure modes to model properly.

Marketplace money movement: splits, balances, fees, payouts, and settlement. This is the part of the platform where being nearly right isn't a category that exists.

Merchant accounts and onboarding: the services behind automated onboarding, underwriting, and the account lifecycle.

In-person payments: our card-present estate, terminals, and the flows that connect physical checkouts to the same platform.

Post-transaction flows: refunds, disputes and chargebacks, reconciliation, and reporting the unglamorous surfaces that merchants judge us on.

European expansion: new markets, new payment methods, and the platform work that comes with operating in more places.

The platform itself: our event-driven service estate on AWS, our infrastructure-as-code, our observability, and the tooling that keeps a small team shipping fast.

Responsibilities

Build and ship: Deliver backend features end-to-end, from design through to production, to a consistently high standard.

Design for correctness: Write services that behave under retries, partial failure, and concurrency. Idempotency, consistency, and accurate money maths are the job, not edge cases.

Own it in production: Take real ownership of what you ship instrumentation, alerting, on-call, and incident response in a regulated payments environment

jobs.title: AI Product Lead
jobs.description:
About Aspora

People on the move deserve a bank that moves with them. Since 2022, Aspora has been building a borderless financial operating system that makes money as mobile and transparent as its users.  Backed by influential venture capitalists like Sequoia Capital, Greylock Partners, Hummingbird Ventures, Y Combinator & Global Founders Capital. We're a team of 150+ across India, the UK, the UAE, EU and the US, working with extreme ownership, radical candour, and an obsession with customer impact.  We celebrate builders who question assumptions, ship fast, and turn regulatory complexity into elegant solutions. If you’re driven to redefine what global banking can be, we’d love to build the future with you.

About the Role

People build lives across borders, and Aspora moves their money with them. Aisha is our next bet: an AI finance agent for NRIs that does the work end to end. Most agent companies build the intelligence and hope the rails come later. We already have the rails. This role exists to build the intelligence NRIs will trust with real money.  You will own Aisha completely: product, roadmap, team and results. You’ll report directly to our CEO. You’ll work closely with compliance, legal and our payments teams across the UAE, UK and India. The hard calls are yours: what to build, buy or partner on, and when the agent is ready to act.

Who You Are

To you, an AI agent is only worth building if it finishes the job. You’ve built consumer products people rely on every day, and you’ve shipped AI that holds up in the real world.

You’ve built consumer before.  You founded or ran a product people used daily, and you know what users forgive and what loses their trust for good.

You’ve shipped AI that works in production.  You have operated evals, orchestration, tool use and failure modes yourself, not just read about them.

You bring money-grade judgement.  You’ve worked where mistakes move other people’s money, or you can show you learn regulated domains fast.

You lead by doing.  You stay close enough to the product and the code to make the call yourself.

You’ve moved quickly everywhere you’ve been.  Your track record shows people kept trusting you with more, sooner than expected.

You’ve been tested.  A failed launch, a company that died or a regulatory wall. You made sound calls under pressure and followed through to the end.

Most importantly, you want to prove that AI can be trusted with people’s money.

What You’ll Own

This role comes with a founder’s mandate, inside a company that already has licences, partners and customers.

Own Aisha end to end.  Take it from early build to a product NRIs trust with real money tasks.

Shape the agent stack.  Decide what to build, buy or partner on across models, orchestration, data connections and agent payment rails.

Make reliability the product.  Build an agent that completes long, multi-step tasks, with evals, guardrails and failure modes treated as core features.

Ship consumer-grade experience

jobs.title: Infrastructure Engineer (ML Compute) - London
jobs.description:
You’ll own the GPU compute that powers our model training, evaluation and serving systems.  This role sits in our Infrastructure team, which works at the lowest layers of our stack, from Kubernetes down to the GPU hardware. You’ll run the clusters, GPUs and schedulers that our research, product and platform teams depend on, and manage the capacity we buy from our cloud providers.

What success looks like  Success is measured by how well we use our GPUs: keeping production reliable and improving the performance of our training and serving stack.

What you’ll be doing

Running Kubernetes clusters for GPU training and inference

Improving how GPU work is scheduled and placed

Detecting, draining and repairing unhealthy GPU nodes

Managing capacity with our cloud providers

Debugging failures in GPUs, Linux, storage and networking

The first year  By month 3, you’ll be handling a share of cluster incidents on your own and will have shipped one change to scheduling or node health, such as automatically detecting and draining unhealthy GPU nodes. By month 6, you’ll own one part of the compute layer outright: scheduling and placement, node health and repair, or capacity and new regions. By month 12, you’ll be responsible for a globally distributed GPU system that shifts capacity between training and inference as needs change.

Who you’ll work with  Your hiring manager is our VP of Engineering. Day to day, you’ll work with the Platform Infrastructure team, the research and product teams who use our compute, and our cloud providers and other vendors.

What we think it takes

You’re likely a good fit if you:

Have built and run GPU workloads on Kubernetes

Could design a GPU cluster for training and online RL from scratch

Debug confidently at the OS layer and below (Linux, GPU drivers, networking and storage)

Write strong Python

It’s a plus if you’ve worked as an SRE or infrastructure engineer, or have used:

Slurm

Kubernetes scheduling and autoscaling tools such as Kueue or Karpenter

Multi-cloud orchestration tools such as SkyPilot

AWS services such as EKS or SageMaker HyperPod

High-performance interconnects and collective communication libraries such as EFA, InfiniBand, NCCL or Open MPI

Terraform

You don’t need ML research experience. If you match most of this but not every point, please apply.

How we hire  Four stages, about three hours in total: a 30-minute call with our Talent team, a 60-minute coding interview, a 60-minute system design interview and a closing 30-minute conversation with our VP of Engineering. The coding and system design interviews are modelled on real-world problems you’d face in this role.

Practicalities  The role is hybrid, with three days a week in our Paris or London office and occasional travel between the two. We offer a competitive package.  Find more  English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom  on Arbeitnow

jobs.description:
As a Product Designer, you'll work on the H Platform, where our users create and run agentic AI workflows powered by our models. Nobody has written the playbook for designing these experiences yet. Our next stage is making the platform truly useful for its users and levelling it up, in design as much as in technology, and you'll build the product experiences that deliver real value in organisations.  At H Company, we believe AI should take action in the real world, and our mission is to make agentic AI genuinely useful for large organisations. We're pioneers in computer use: our own vision-language models power agents that see, click and type their way through the software businesses already run, with no integrations or rebuilds, and we own the whole stack, from research and models to the products built on top of them.

What you'll be doing

Talking to our users constantly to understand their needs and figure out what will make the platform truly useful for them.

Turning those insights into research and explorations, looking at problems from different angles before settling on a direction.

Picking the right tool for each task: a Figma design, a prototype, or a small PR when a quick change is the fastest way to ship.

Testing what you build with users, measuring its impact (A/B testing, user interviews, users daily use data...) and iterating quickly based on what you learn.

Shaping the roadmap together with the whole team, engineers and PMs alike.

Who you'll work with  The role sits in our Product team, which is responsible for product direction, strategy and design. You'll join the product designer who owns design and UX today, and work closely with product, engineering and forward deployed engineers.

What we think it takes  Above all, we want someone who cares deeply about users, has great product taste and can explain it, moves fast while keeping quality high, leaves their ego at the door and welcomes feedback.

Likely a good fit if you

Have 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer at tech companies.

Have excellent UX, UI and interaction design skills, and can make complex, technical flows, like building and running AI agent workflows, feel simple and intuitive.

Have a portfolio that shows your latest work.

Have hands-on experience running user tests and A/B tests.

Know when a proven solution is good enough and when a problem deserves something new.

Have designed complex data or ML/AI-driven products: you know how to make complex systems understandable and how to design for AI behaviour that isn't always predictable, building trust and keeping users in control.

Are comfortable in technical discussions: you can dig into constraints and trade-offs with engineers and ramp up quickly on technical topics to discuss them with our researchers and more technical engineers.

Are fluent in Figma.

Can work within a design system and contribute to it.

Stronger still if you

Have designed platforms: complex B2B web or desktop software used

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - London
jobs.description:
About H:

When we released  Holo4  on 28 September, we published every trajectory behind its public benchmark scores at  trajectories.hcompany.ai . For OSWorld that's 369 desktop tasks, each run 3 times, with the steps, tokens and time of every attempt. This role builds and runs the evaluation framework that produces runs like these.  H builds computer-use agents and the models behind them. Developers use them through a  managed API , and our forward deployed engineers take them into enterprise workflows.

What this team owns  The evaluation framework: orchestration, runtimes and observability. Researchers and forward deployed engineers bring the benchmarks, across web apps, desktop applications and the command line. Your job is to make the framework that runs them reliable, fast and cheap, and to make adding a new one quick. Research uses the results to choose checkpoints and decide whether a model ships. Product and the forward deployed engineers use them to measure agents on customer workflows. It carries roughly 50 benchmarks now. That number should be between 100 and 200 soon, and the framework has to keep up.

What you'd be doing

Integration support for researchers and forward deployed engineers bringing in a benchmark, with a shorter path each time.

Setting the standard for how a benchmark enters the framework, and building the checks that enforce it.

Scheduling and observability, so cluster capacity isn't left idle while evaluation jobs queue.

Reproducible results across trials, so a release decision rests on numbers that hold.

Whatever stack a benchmark calls for. One week that's cluster tuning; the next it's a browser extension or desktop environments.

Time with customers, from single developers to large companies, to find out what they want measured, then automating it so the results flow back into our harnesses and models.

The first few months  By 3 months you'll have helped researchers or forward deployed engineers integrate 5 benchmarks, and started fixing what slows the framework down. By 6 months one part of it is yours, for example scaling the runs, observability, or a group of related benchmarks, and a release will have gone out on your numbers. By 12 months you'll know the design and trade-offs of the whole evaluation system, and be the person the rest of H asks about evaluations.

Who you'd work with  Ceiran Chapman, our VP Engineering, is hiring for this role. You'd join the evaluation team. The people relying on your work day to day are H's researchers and forward deployed engineers.

What we think it takes

Likely a good fit if you

Have spent 5+ years in backend development, with production Python at the core, and use coding agents to go faster without letting quality drop.

Have built test, QA or evaluation tooling that other teams depended on, and care whether a number is right.

Have operated distributed systems on Kubernetes in a public cloud. AWS experience helps most.

Have built and shipped systems end to end

Cypress  Running a business today means operating in one world and understanding in another. The owner lives in a stream of real-world events — deliveries, staffing, inventory, customers — context-switching into spreadsheets, dashboards, and reports to make sense of the data. These two realities never quite line up. Cypress collapses the distance between business reality and understanding.  We are building a generational company to enable the future of ownership. Our platform continuously models a business as it runs, constructing a living representation that agents can act on and owners can collaborate with. The result is something that hasn't existed before: businesses that understand themselves. This changes who can own a business, how those businesses are operated, and how far they can go.  Cypress Labs is backed by top-tier venture capital and a roster of angel investors with operational expertise. Founded by Spencer Wilson (MIT, Marshall Scholar, UCL neuroscience PhD, previously Ctrl-Labs and Trisk Bio) and Josh Hone (first commercial hire at bootstrapped Quorum, COO at venture-backed Column).  We're working in person in London.  The Role  An extraordinary designer is one of our first hires because design is central to the problem we're solving. You will own the entire surface area of how owners interact with our system: the grammar of interaction, the visual language, and the code that brings it to life.  Your work sits at the boundary of product, research, and infrastructure. You will transform dense event streams and simulations into views that are beautiful, clear, and immediately useful to busy people running real businesses in the physical world.  What You Will Do

Define the visual language and patterns of interaction for an AI-native product from square one

Design and build owner-facing views that make complex business operations legible and actionable

Create the information design layer between our intelligence engine and the owners it serves

Ship production code in a modern frontend stack

Establish the taste bar for everything the user touches

Significant product design experience at organizations where craft and tempo are taken seriously. You know what excellence looks like, your bar is high. NB: we are open to a broad range of experience levels if your work speaks for itself and we see clear indications of high learning rate.

A portfolio that reveals clear thinking about the underlying problem, not just beautifully arranged pixels.

Fluency shipping in a modern frontend stack, and a desire to learn new technologies as needed.

Systems thinking. You reason about state, sequence, and context, not just layout.

Genuine interest in how AI rewrites the rules of interfaces.

High agency. You identify the right problem, propose a direction, and build it.

jobs.description:
Evervault is hiring its first Security Engineer in London.  We build modular card payment infrastructure for companies building payment products or their own payments stack. Our tools help developers keep raw card data off their systems, reduce PCI compliance work, and improve payment acceptance, fees and fraud outcomes. Our customers include Rippling, Ramp and Sorare.  We’re a Series B company backed by Index Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Kleiner Perkins.  You’ll join our platform group and own application security from day one, with scope to take responsibility for security across Evervault over time. You’ll be our first dedicated security engineer, working closely with the engineers who build and run our products.  In your first year, expect roughly half your time to go towards hands-on security engineering and half towards audits, questionnaires and customer security reviews. Both are core to the job. You’ll help make our systems more secure and give customers confidence in how we protect their data.  Your work will include:

Finding and fixing vulnerabilities in our applications and infrastructure.

Building security checks and tooling into how we develop and ship software.

Working with engineers on security decisions in product and system design.

Owning security and compliance audits, including evidence collection and resolving findings.

Handling customer security reviews and questionnaires, and explaining our controls clearly.

You’ll establish how the security function works through the code you ship, the risks you address and the practices you help the team adopt.  We work mostly in Rust and Node.js on AWS, with Terraform and some Go. We care more about your engineering ability than experience with every part of our stack.  We’re looking for an excellent engineer with deep, practical security expertise. You should be comfortable writing production code, investigating unfamiliar systems and taking a fix through to completion. Strong engineering skills and hands-on experience with the Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) are both essential.  Experience in card payments, particularly running or securing a cardholder data environment, is a strong signal. You’ve taken audits through to resolution and worked at a product company before Series C. Experience as a first or sole security engineer would be valuable.  You use AI daily and actively look for ways it can improve your work. You’re comfortable making progress when the problem is loosely defined, and you take responsibility for the result. We’d also like to hear about something exceptional you’ve done, at work or outside it.  This is an individual contributor role. You’ll have ownership and close collaboration within the platform team, with no immediate people-management remit. We welcome mid-level and senior engineers. jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
About Evervault

Evervault provides online card payment infrastructure primarily to companies building card payments into their products, as well as to sophisticated merchants who manage payment routing in-house. Best-in-class companies like Ramp, Overwolf, and Modern Treasury build their products on top of Evervault.  Beyond that, we are extending our core encryption technology to secure sensitive data for use cases outside of card payments, including banking, healthcare, identity, crypto, and more. Our mission is to become the clearinghouse for sensitive data, so companies can move data freely between systems without the compliance and security overhead.

The Role  Traditional BDR tactics are broken. We need someone who can identify and engage CTOs, CPOs, VPs of ProdEng and founders at 100-5,000 person companies during their moments of genuine need - not with generic cold emails, but through strategic timing and thoughtful outreach.

What Success Looks Like

16 Qualified Opportunities generated per quarter

Making inroads into target accounts via strategic stakeholder mapping, cold calling, in person events, and email/socials to our target personas

Becoming an SME in the card payments domain

What You'll Do

Signal-Based Prospecting:  Track the moments that create a need for card infrastructure, such as a company adding a second PSP, expanding into new geographies, launching card issuing or embedded payments, hiring its first payments engineer or compliance lead, or facing a PCI DSS audit or renewal.

Payments-Led Research:  Map a target account's current payment stack (processors, vault, checkout, 3DS provider) and pinpoint where they're likely feeling pain, whether that's PCI scope weighing on engineering, vendor lock-in with a single processor, declining authorization rates, or rising fraud and chargeback exposure.

Relevant Outreach:  Engage CTOs, CPOs, VPs of Product and Engineering, and founders through calls, email, LinkedIn, and warm intros, with messaging tied to outcomes they care about: reducing PCI compliance burden, owning card data to route freely across processors, lifting auth rates with network tokens and card account updater, and bringing down fraud and chargebacks with 3DS.

Cold Calling:  Run consistent call blocks into target accounts to start conversations with technical buyers and learn how they handle card data today.

Domain Expertise:  Build a working knowledge of card payments, including tokenization, payment orchestration, network tokens, 3DS, PCI DSS v4.0, and the card network rules on disputes, so you can hold credible first conversations with technical executives.

Community and Events:  Build relationships in fintech, payments, and founder/CTO communities, and help turn in-person events and meetups into pipeline in target markets.

Partner-Sourced Pipeline:  Work with VCs, PSPs, consultants, and complementary vendors to source warm introductions into accounts where Evervault fits.

We're unlocking access to the NHS, because healthcare is not truly free until it's truly accessible 💙

The world’s best healthcare, for free. It's not a new idea, it's called the NHS. But the largest healthcare provider is fundamentally broken. Patient satisfaction is at an all time low, and the biggest reason cited is lack of access. So we’re on a mission to fix it with technology that actually works.  We're building the front door of UK healthcare, creating a future where one billion NHS appointments are transparent and instantly bookable, and patients are guided to the right service first time using AI.  We're developing critical national infrastructure. Today, 26% of GP practices in England use our patient registration software, while one in five GP practices in London use  Bookable  Search to help new patients find and book appointments seamlessly.  Our latest product, Bookable Navigator, extends this vision by automatically booking appointments for existing patients. Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Solid background operating containerized services on AWS cloud environments using Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform.

Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL.

Experience working with geospatial data technologies (e.g., GeoServer) or spatial indexing algorithms.

You save videos for their brilliant execution and immediately start thinking about how you’d make something even better.

You’ll create and edit product-launch videos and original social videos designed to grab attention and get shared. Working with our launch team, you’ll turn product-marketing messages into creative concepts and storyboards, then generate the images and video sequences with AI. You’ll lead the creative direction and own the edit, obsessing over hooks, storytelling, pacing and sound just as much as the visuals.

You’ll work alongside a dedicated motion designer, combining the videos you generate with AI with their animation and compositing. From shaping the first idea to generating the right shots and editing the final cut, you’ll turn our products’ capabilities into videos that make people excited to try them.

What you will do

  • Lead the creative direction: Turn product-marketing messages into original concepts, hooks and storyboards. Own how we bring each launch to life, making people excited about what they can create.
  • Generate videos with AI: Create images, video sequences and unexpected visual effects. Choose the right tools and refine your prompts and shots until the result matches your creative vision.
  • Own the edit: Create product-launch videos and original social videos people can’t ignore. Bring everything together through strong storytelling, pacing, music and sound, giving people a reason to watch and share.
  • Lead production: Work with the launch team and brief your dedicated motion designer, combining AI-generated videos with animation and compositing. Own the work from the first concept through revisions to the final cut.

jobs.title: Senior ML Engineer | Kimchi (LLM Inference Optimization)
jobs.description:
Why Cast AI?

Cast AI is an automation platform that operates cloud-native and AI infrastructure at scale. By embedding autonomous decision-making directly into Kubernetes and cloud environments, Cast AI continuously optimizes performance, reliability, and efficiency in production.
The old way doesn't work. As Kubernetes and AI environments grow, manual decisions don’t. Cast AI replaces tickets, alerts, and manual tuning with continuous automation that adapts infrastructure as conditions change. Efficiency and cost savings follow naturally from that automation.
Over 2,100 companies already rely on Cast AI, including Akamai, BMW, Cisco, FICO, HuggingFace, NielsenIQ, Swisscom, and TGS.

Global team, diverse perspectives

We're headquartered in Miami, but our impact is international. We take a global and intentional approach to diversity. Today, Cast AI operates across 34 countries spanning Europe, North America, Latin America, and APAC, bringing a wide range of perspectives into how we build and lead.

Unicorn momentum

In January 2026, we achieved unicorn status with a strategic investment from Pacific Alliance Ventures, the corporate venture arm of Shinsegae Group (a $50+ billion Korean conglomerate). Our valuation now exceeds $1 billion, and we're just getting started.

Join us as we build the future of autonomous infrastructure.

About the role

Throughput. Latency. KV cache utilization.

Move those three numbers in the right direction, and two things happen: customers get faster, cheaper inference, and our margins improve. That's the entire thesis of this role. Every kernel you tune, every quantization scheme you ship, every scheduler tweak you land shows up directly in a customer's p99 and on our P&L.
This is a high-impact seat. It is also a high-autonomy seat as you'll be given the room to lead the technical direction of inference optimization at Kimchi, not execute someone else's roadmap.

The problem: running LLMs in production is a moving target. The "right" model and serving configuration for a workload depend on traffic shape, sequence-length distribution, batch dynamics, GPU SKU, memory bandwidth, quantization tolerance, and a dozen other variables that shift week to week. Most teams pick a model once, over-provision GPUs, and absorb the cost. Kimchi is the system that makes that decision automatically - continuously matching workloads to the most cost-efficient, best-performing LLM and serving configuration on a customer's infrastructure. We're building the optimization layer between the model and the hardware, and we need engineers who understand both sides deeply.

Stack

Python; vLLM; SGLang; TensorRT-LLM; PyTorch; CUDA-adjacent tooling; Kubernetes; gRP; ClickHouse; PostgreSQL; GCP Pub/Sub; AWS / GCP / Azure; GitLab CI; ArgoCD; Prometheus; Grafana; Loki; Tem

xHeron is building the Service-as-Software company for short-term rental operators.  We take responsibility for guest communication, team coordination and issue resolution, so customers can hand over the work without handing over their business.

Today, we deliver that service through people, software and AI. We’re turning the expertise behind it into autonomous systems that understand situations, take action and follow through.  Not another tool to supervise. A service that gets the job done.

We’re looking for an  AI Engineer  to build the agentic capabilities at the heart of xHeron. You’ll help shape how our agents reason, act and learn, and build a company where AI doesn’t just support the work, but increasingly delivers it.

Tasks

We are looking for an AI Harness Engineer to build the software layer that turns language models into dependable operational systems.

You will work on orchestration, context assembly, tool execution, state, permissions, evaluations, observability, failure recovery, and human handoffs. The goal is not merely to generate a good response.

Agent harness architecture:  Build the control layer around models: task decomposition, state management, model and tool selection, execution loops, checkpoints, retries, stopping conditions, and human handoffs.

Decision and execution behavior:  Design how agents interpret situations, choose actions, manage uncertainty, and complete bounded operational tasks—not only how they generate text.

Context and memory:  Determine what an agent needs to know at each step. Build context assembly, retrieval, memory, evidence selection, and knowledge-maintenance strategies while managing relevance, latency, and cost.

Tools and real-world effects:  Connect agents to APIs and operational systems through explicit tool contracts, permissions, validation, idempotency, and confirmation that the intended effect actually occurred.

Evaluation and regression testing:  Build representative evaluation suites and automated tests for decision quality, tool use, task completion, safety, escalation behavior, and recurring failure patterns.

Observability and failure analysis:  Make agent behavior inspectable through structured traces, state, outcomes, and error classification. Diagnose failures across models, prompts, context, tools, and surrounding software.

Continuous improvement:  Use evaluations, production traces, operator feedback, and controlled experiments to improve prompts, context, tools, model choices, and agent architecture.

Production ownership:  Ship and operate production Python software alongside our CTO and engineering team. Work closely with systems engineering on integrations, authorization, durable state, recovery, and safe execution.

You are a strong software engineer who can design, build, test, and operate reliable production systems in Python.

About The Role

We’re looking for a  Security Engineer  to own and improve the security of our internal environment — the identities, SaaS apps, endpoints, AI tooling, and networks our employees use every day. This is a hands-on senior role: we expect you to design controls, find the gaps, and drive the changes that close them — and to build the automation that makes it scale.  We’re an EMI-licensed fintech in a fully cloud-native AWS environment, we use AI heavily, and we’re growing fast. We need someone who can lead technical initiatives independently, influence our security architecture, challenge approaches that no longer fit, and explain it clearly to engineers and leadership.

Your Mission

Detection & Response (SIEM) — our top priority

Own SIEM alerting end-to-end: ship logs from endpoints, IdP, VPN, SaaS, and cloud; write and tune detection rules; cut false positives.  Act as first responder for security incidents — investigate, contain, drive to closure with clear runbooks — and feed recurring issues back into preventive controls.

Identity, Access & SaaS

Administer the IdP (SSO via SAML/OIDC, MFA, conditional access) and run access recertification end-to-end across IdP, SaaS, AWS, and internal tools — scope, evidence, follow-through on revocations. jobs.title: Teamleiter Last Mile Logistik (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Kurz und Knapp

Du liebst die tägliche Abwechslung, siehst dich als (zukünftige) Führungskraft, um dein Team zum Erfolg zu führen und bist bereit für eine neue Herausforderung in der Logistik?

Dann bist du bei Picnic genau richtig! Denn wir suchen nach einem Graduate Teamlead für unseren Last Mile Standort (Hub) in Wolfsburg.
Die Hubs werden mit unseren bereits fertig kommissionierten Waren aus dem Zentrallager (Fulfillment Center) beliefert und sind als Verteilzentrum die letzte Station unserer Logistikkette, bevor die Einkäufe beim Kunden auf dem Küchentisch landen.

Das erwartet dich

  • Teamführung: Stelle dein Team ein und coache es zum Erfolg. Du kannst auch tolle Events planen, um den Zusammenhalt weiter zu stärken.
  • Entwicklung zur Führungskraft: Du managst nicht nur die Schichtpläne, sondern übernimmst die Einarbeitung und Entwicklung der Runner (Fahrer) in einem unserer Hubs, und sorgst so dafür, dass alles rund läuft.
  • Liefermanagement: Du übernimmst die Verantwortung, wenn die Lkw mit frischen Waren ankommen, und sorgst dafür, dass alles passt! Und wenn etwas fehlt, organisierst du blitzschnell Nachlieferungen – du behältst immer den Überblick über doe Logistik in deinem Standort.
  • Prozessmanagement: Du hältst den Betrieb am Laufen durch einen kontinuierlich den Fokus auf unsere betrieblichen Kennzahlen (KPIs) und garantierst, dass alles sicher und wie am Schnürchen läuft, ganz nach unserem Motto: “Safety First”.
  • Teamwork: Im engen Austausch mit dem Customer-Success Team, unserem Zentrallager (Fulfillment Center) und anderen Hubs machst du unsere Kunden glücklich.
  • Pünktliche Abfahrten: Dank dir sind unsere Fahrer immer pünktlich unterwegs zu unseren Kunden, damit wir unser versprochenes Zeitfenster einhalten können.
  • Bringe deine Ideen ein: Von der Koordination der Reparatur unserer Elektrofahrzeuge über die Gestaltung des Hub Layouts bis hin zur Rekrutierung unserer Runner - deine Ideen tragen dazu bei, dass wir gemeinsam weiter wachsen können und unsere Logistikprozesse auf ein neues Level bringen.

Das bringst du mit

  • Ein Studium oder abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung in der Logistik, dem Einzelhandel oder in ähnlichen Bereichen.
  • Erste Erfahrungen in der Führung von Teams - entweder im Beruf oder du hast bereits ein anderes Erfolgsteam gecoached.
  • Fließende Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.
  • Du bist im Besitz eines gültigen Führerscheins der Klasse B.
  • Gute kommunikat

jobs.title: Praktikum Business Analytics (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Kurz und knapp

Als Business Analyst Intern bei Picnic bist du an vorderster Front der Innovation und stellst dich komplexen Herausforderungen mit bahnbrechenden Lösungen. Diese Rolle dreht sich um Innovation – du analysierst Daten, unterstützt Chancen zu identifizieren und Strategien zu entwickeln, die Grenzen überschreiten und das Einkaufserlebnis zu revolutionieren. Während deines Praktikums arbeitest du eng mit erfahrenen Analyst:innen zusammen, erhältst Mentoring und entwickelst die Fähigkeiten, um optimal für eine mögliche Vollzeitstelle als Business Analyst bei uns vorbereitet zu sein.

Dort bringst du dich ein

  • Logistik – Optimiere das Rückgrat unserer Prozesse – von den Fulfillment-Centern über die Zustellung unserer last-mile bis hin zur Nachfrageprognose in ganz Europa. Think: Automatisierung internationaler Lieferprognosen für Wachstumsmärkte wie München.

  • Consumer – Treibe das Wachstum durch Preisgestaltung, effektive Lieferantenbeziehungen und unsere Marktstrategie voran. Think: Mitgestaltung unseres erfolgreichen Markteintritts in neue Städte. Deine Entscheidungen prägen das Einkaufserlebnis von Millionen von Kundinnen und Kunden bei Picnic.

Das erwartet dich

  • Löse echte Herausforderungen: Stelle dich kritischen Geschäftsfragen, die das Geschäftsmodell von Picnic täglich prägen. Neugierig auf die Fragen?

  • Ermögliche: Erreiche operative Exzellenz, indem du Herausforderungen mit einem datengetriebenen und analytischen Ansatz meisterst

  • Entwickle: Erstelle und optimiere Modelle für Verbesserungen in Echtzeit

  • Kommuniziere: Arbeite effektiv mit verschiedenen Teams zusammen, um wirkungsvolle und nachhaltige Lösungen zu liefern

  • Übernimm Verantwortung: Zeige Initiative, indem du den Status quo in Frage stellst und Prozesse neu denkst. Nur weil es immer so gemacht wurde, heißt das nicht, dass es der beste Weg ist. Probier’s aus!

Das bringst du mit

  • Eingeschrieben in einem Masterstudium in einem quantitativen Feld (e.g., Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Econometrics, oder Ähnliches)

  • Du hast eine Leidenschaft für Datenanalyse und Unternehmensberatung

  • Deine Kommunikationsfähigkeiten ermöglichen es dir, abstrakte Pläne in verständliche Informationen für dein Team umzuwandeln

  • Sprichst fließend Englisch; Deutschkenntnisse sind ein Plus

  • Du besitzt die Staatsbürgerschaft eines EU-Mitgliedstaates

  • Verfügbarkeit: mindestens 4-6 Monate für ein reguläres

jobs.title: Account Receivable Specialist
jobs.description:
fal is the generative media ecosystem powering the next generation of AI products. We build the infrastructure, tools, and model access that teams need to move from idea to production, and do it at scale without compromise. For developers and enterprises, fal is the foundation that makes generative media not just possible, but practical: a unified platform where high-performance inference, orchestration, and observability come together to unlock new categories of AI-native products.  As generative media reshapes industries across a market projected to grow by hundreds of billions over the next decade, fal is becoming the ecosystem that ambitious teams build on.

About the Role

Cash flow is the fuel behind every hire we make and every GPU we spin up — and right now, that process runs on scrappy startup instincts more than scalable systems. We're hiring an AR Specialist to change that: someone who can take full ownership of collections, chase down what's owed without losing the relationship, and build the reporting and processes that let Finance actually see around corners. You'll sit at the intersection of Finance, Sales, Operations, and Customer Success, which means your work is never just about invoices — it's about making sure the whole revenue engine runs cleanly as we scale. If you get real satisfaction from replacing chaos with a system that just works, this role was built for you.

What You'll Do

Own Accounts Receivable, start to finish

Run the full Account Receivable  lifecycle — invoicing, payment tracking, account reconciliation

Watch aging reports like a hawk and chase down outstanding invoices before they become a problem

Keep customer account records clean and resolve billing discrepancies fast

Support month-end close for everything AR and cash application related

Drive collections and cash flow

Design and execute collection strategies that shrink DSO and speed up cash collections

Build real relationships with customer AP teams — the kind that get payment delays resolved with a phone call, not an escalation

Know when to escalate high-risk or delinquent accounts, and do it without burning the relationship

Spot payment risk early by reading the trends before they become write-offs

Build the systems, not just run them

Use collections tools to automate outreach and track performance — this isn't a spreadsheets-forever role

Partner with Finance leadership to level up AR processes, reporting, and controls

Work with Sales to make sure billing is accurate from the first invoice

Help build the scalable AR playbook a high-growth startup actually needs

Report on what matters

Put together weekly AR aging and collections reports for leadership

Track DSO, collection effectiveness, and overdue balances like they're your own scorecard

Support audits and keep documentation clean for compliance

Qualifications/Nice to haves:

3+ years in Accounts Receivable, Billing, or Collections

Comfortable in a SaaS, tech, or startup environmen

jobs.title: Working Student - CAD design
jobs.description:
We’re building the world’s fastest way to design real, functional 3D parts. Kyrall’s AI-powered design agent turns ideas into ready-to-manufacture 3D models in seconds. Backed by top European VCs, we’re a young, well-funded startup based in Munich, and we’re just getting started.

The Role 
You’ll bring the engineering perspective to our AI. You’ll build parametric CAD models, check whether what our design agent generates would hold up in a real workshop, and help define what “good design” means for our models.

What To Expect

Build clean, fully parametric CAD models of real mechanical parts

Review AI-generated models for design intent, manufacturability and correctness

Create benchmark parts and test cases to evaluate our design agent

Give structured feedback to the AI and data teams to improve model quality

Your Profile

Studying mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, product design or similar

Hands-on experience with parametric CAD (e.g. SolidWorks, Onshape, CATIA, Siemens NX or Fusion)

Good understanding of design for manufacturing (machining, sheet metal or 3D printing)

Precise, structured and self-driven way of working

20 hours per week, on-site in Munich

Nice To Have

Experience with technical drawings and GD&T

Basic Python or CAD scripting skills

Why Kyrall? 
We’re reinventing how machines are designed and built, from the ground up. 3D modeling tools were the last major leap in this space, and the way we design parts today has hit its limit. You’ll work directly with the founders and AI team on a small, fast-moving team, and see your work land in the product within weeks.  Find  Jobs in Germany  on Arbeitnow

Mind. 5 Jahre Erfahrung als Product Manager, idealerweise mit Fokus auf Web-Anwendungen

Fundierte Führungserfahrung im Product Management, bestenfalls im Start-up-Umfeld mit schnellen Iterationen, wechselnden Anforderungen und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum

Nachweislich datengetriebene Arbeitsweise mit KPIs, Analytics, User Behavior und Nutzerfeedback

Nachweisliche Erfahrung darin, Roadmaps zu bauen und Delivery aktiv zu treiben – von der Priorisierung bis zum Release

Erfahrung mit UX-/UI-Design (Figma) und Prototyping

Know-how in E-Commerce/Webshop inkl. CRO und A/B-Testing

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff Intern - Germany
jobs.description:
DRYFT

Ideas only change the world when you build them at scale. That’s what Dryft is here for.  Dryft builds models that automate complex human decisions in manufacturing operations. We capture the knowledge of experienced operators across supply chain, production planning, engineering and more, simulate the consequences of their decisions, and use this understanding to help run their business. Our customers include some of the largest robotics, machine and component manufacturers in the world.  We’re a small, talent-dense team with modest roots and a love for the physical world: cars, machines, planes. Our team includes graduates from Stanford, Berkeley, CDTM and TUM, winners of Stanford TreeHacks, recipients of Fulbright & Haniel scholarships, and people who have built everything from robots and race cars to software with millions of downloads.  What matters more to us than credentials is how people work: humility, hard work, speed, kindness, deep customer care, and a willingness to take on problems others avoid. Working at Dryft is hard. You get unusual ownership early on, with real responsibility. But that’s also what makes it one of the biggest learning experiences of your life.  We’re backed by founders and operators behind some of the most legendary tech companies of our time, Tier-1 U.S. venture firms, and board members of global industrial companies.  ERPs ran the physical world for half a century. Dryft is building the intelligence layer that will power the next.  ​

THE ROLE

As a  Member of Technical Staff Intern , you'll build the system that decides how some of the largest manufacturers in the world operate. That means combining agent-based reasoning with mathematical optimization and simulation on large-scale industrial data.

Build agents people trust  – when an agent runs a factory's week, the largest industrial companies in the world have to trust it with their critical processes and understand every decision it makes; you build the routing, orchestration and guardrails behind that

Ship features end-to-end  – you understand the user need, and you get the freedom to build it across the LLM pipeline, infrastructure, backend and frontend, in production in your first weeks

Work close to the users  – sit with the planners who use it, see what would make their work 10x faster, and build it

You'll own your own features from day one, and what you ship decides what a plant does next week.  ​

YOU

Full-stack shipper  – you've shipped production code end-to-end, you build scalable backend and infra that handles massive amounts of structured and unstructured data, and you build the interface that makes it usable

Highly technical  – you've built something technically hard, and you can walk us through every decision behind it

Product sense  – you spot the feature hiding in a user's complaint, and you've deleted your own favorite one because nobody used it

You care about getting it right  – you know when it has to be 100% and when to k

By connecting LLMs to high-quality, trustworthy web content, we help developers build agents that are not only intelligent — but also informed.

We work with some of the most innovative teams in AI — from small startups shaping the ecosystem to the largest enterprises deploying AI at scale. Whether it's powering sales assistants, research copilots, or internal knowledge tools, we're the missing link between LLMs and the real world.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to build the rendering infrastructure behind a novel search engine designed for agentic AI. In this role, you will design systems that transform modern web applications into high quality structured content for search and AI. You will work on browser rendering, JavaScript execution, and large-scale rendering infrastructure capable of processing billions of pages efficiently. Modern websites increasingly rely on client-side rendering, dynamic data loading, and complex application frameworks. Your work will ensure we can reliably render, understand, and extract valuable information while minimising cost and latency.

In this position, your responsibility will be to:

  • Design and build large-scale rendering systems for modern web applications
  • Develop browser-based rendering infrastructure capable of executing complex JavaScript applications reliably
  • Research how modern frontend frameworks render and deliver content
  • Improve rendering quality, completeness, and performance across diverse websites
  • Optimise rendering cost, latency, resource utilisation, and throughput at internet scale
  • Translate rendering research into reliable production systems

You may be a good fit if you:

Have 5+ years of experience as a software engineer working on production backend or infrastructure systems and are an expert in several of the following areas:

  • Browser Rendering
  • Chromium rendering pipeline — DOM, Layout, Paint, and Compositing
  • JavaScript execution inside browsers and rendering lifecycle and page readiness
  • Head

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Vertical Search
jobs.description:
The role

Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.

Vertical search is where we combine public sources with premium vertical data and shape the result into a product for a specific use case. This role owns that layer end to end. You decide which industries and use cases we productize. With the data team, you find and evaluate the public and premium data providers behind each one. You shape the product surface that sits on top.

You will sit with customers in these industries, learn how they actually work, and turn their needs and pain points into clear specs. You will build with engineering, ship it, and make sure go-to-market knows how to sell it. You own the outcome, not just the handoff: from the first market call through to adoption and revenue.

The hard part is choosing. There are more verticals worth building than we can build, and the difference between a good year and a wasted one is knowing which ones to invest in and which to walk away from, even when a large customer is asking for another.

In your first year, we expect you to know our top use cases better than anyone here, ship a product built for one of them that customers will pay more for, and have a defensible view of what comes next.

This is a hands-on senior IC role with real ownership. You will work within a small PM team reporting to the Director of Product, alongside engineering, research, data, and go-to-market.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Own the vertical roadmap. You decide where we invest, what we ship for each, and when a vertical is not worth it.
  • Shape the product surface on top of the data, so a customer gets something built for their job.
  • Find and evaluate the data behind each vertical, across public sources and paid providers, and decide what is worth investing in.
  • Sit with customers in these industries until you understand their workflow, then turn that into specs engineering can build.
  • Set what a good answer looks like in each use case, working with our evaluation team, who own how we measure it.
  • Work with customer success to learn what customers ask us for and what makes them leave.
  • Partner with the search owner on how results should be ranked and shaped for each use case.

We expect you to have:

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with a meaningful portion in search, data, or industry-specific AI products.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Search Infrastructure
jobs.description:
The role

Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.

We build and run our own index. That means we own the hard problems directly: crawl coverage at scale, freshness, cost per query, and the quality of what comes back. This role owns that infrastructure as a product.

When an agent asks a question, the answer has to be relevant, fresh, fast, and affordable. Those four things pull against each other, and someone has to decide which one gives. That is you. You will set what good means for each use case we serve and the bar a change has to clear before it ships, working closely with our evaluation team, who own how we measure it. You will also shape where our index goes next: what it needs to cover, how fresh it needs to be, and what it has to be good at.

The most open part of the job is what comes next. Search is being rebuilt for a consumer that is not a person. Agents do not want one result page, they want to break a problem apart, run many retrievals, and decide what to do next. That changes what search infrastructure should look like, and part of your job is to have a view on where ours should go.

The hard part is deciding what good enough means. Perfect coverage, perfect freshness, and low cost cannot all be true at once, and the person in this seat is the one who has to make that call for each use case and defend it.

In your first year, we expect you to set a clear quality bar for our search products that the team builds against, have a real influence on where our index goes next, and bring us a point of view on where search infrastructure is heading.

This is a hands-on senior IC role with real ownership, reporting to the Director of Product. You will work day to day with our search engineering and research teams, with the evaluation team, and with customer success, who bring us quality feedback from real accounts every week. Our search engineers are deeply experienced in large-scale retrieval, and the product team is small, so you will argue your case directly with the people building it. That only works if you have built at this scale yourself.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Set the quality bar and release criteria for search: what good means per use case, and what a change has to clear before it ships. Our evaluation team owns the measurement, and you work closely with them on what to measure and why.
  • Own the depth, latency, and cost tradeoffs across our search products, and make them explicit and defensible.
  • Shape the direction of our index: what it needs to cover, how fresh it needs to be, and what quality b

jobs.description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.  Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As Kernel Software Engineer, you own the low-level software platform that sits between our hardware and the flight application on our ground control stations. You work across the Linux kernel, board support and a custom Android build, so that every control, display and data link works reliably in the field. You are the bridge between our hardware and application teams, taking a new product line from board bring-up to mass production.

Responsibilities

Bring up, configure and maintain the Linux kernel on our hardware, including device tree, drivers and security patches.

Customize and maintain our Android build, covering system services, permissions, boot sequence and OTA updates.

Integrate controls, display, touch, battery and radio modules, and expose them cleanly to the application layer.

Ensure robust, low-latency SBUS and MAVLink data flows between the controller, the radio and the drone.

Debug hardware and software issues alongside electronics and mechanical engineers, using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers and UART/JTAG.

Define flashing, provisioning, factory test and release procedures with the production team.

Work with QGroundControl engineers and QA to validate system behavior on real hardware.

Join field tests and flight sessions to validate your work in real conditions.

Candidate Requirements

Master’s degree in Embedded Systems, Software Engineering, Electronics or a related field.

3+ years of experience in embedded software development.

Strong command of the Linux kernel (configuration, device tree, drivers, debugging) and of C; C++ is a plus.

Hands-on background customizing AOSP, from HALs and system services to the build system.

Comfortable at the hardware boundary: UART, SPI, I2C, GPIO, USB, display and touch controllers.

Exposure to drones or robotics, including MAVLink or PX4/ArduPilot, is a plus.

Hands-on, autonomous and pragmatic, with curiosity about hardware and the ability to learn quickly.

Professional English for technical documentation and international collaboration.

Shift  records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data. Write and own the firmware for our data-capture hardware: sensors, motion-capture rigs, custom IoT setups, and prototype robots.

Solve multi-sensor synchronization, calibration, and time-stamping so every data point lines up across devices and modalities.

Build the path from device to dataset: communication protocols, on-device logging, and handoff into our data pipeline.

Combine machine learning and classical computer vision approaches where appropriate.

Fuse inertial data, motion information, and visual data to improve detection and tracking in moving image sequences.

Build object tracking pipelines that can switch from initial detection to low-latency tracking once a target has been acquired.

Optimize perception pipelines for embedded execution on NVIDIA Jetson platforms.

Work toward high frame-rate processing targets in the range of 100–300 FPS, where technically feasible.

Use camera intrinsics and extrinsics to transform image-space detections into 3D direction vectors or other navigation-relevant outputs.

jobs.title: Afstudeerstage IT
jobs.description:
Bij BAS, Europa’s grootste dealer in commerciële voertuigen én officieel Volvo en Renault Trucks dealer, krijg jij de kans om je te ontwikkelen binnen IT in de automotive branche. Ben jij  op zoek naar een afstudeerstage vanaf januari/ februari 2027?  Dan is dit iets voor jou!  BAS World groeit hard, en IT speelt daarin een sleutelrol. Binnen ons IT-team liggen verschillende afstudeeropdrachten klaar die elk een echt vraagstuk uit ons IT-landschap aanpakken. Elke opdracht heeft een eigen team dat je dagelijks begeleidt. Zo breng je je kennis in de praktijk en kickstart je samen met ons jouw carrière.  Mogelijke afstudeeropdrachten

1. Continuous performance & load testing (Engineering) 
BAS World wil het aantal voertuigadvertenties online ongeveer 20 keer zo groot maken. In deze opdracht zorg je dat onze websites en systemen die groei aankunnen. Je onderzoekt welke (AI-gedreven) testtools passen bij onze stack. Daarna bouw je samen met het IDP-team een testsuite die dagelijks automatisch draait in de pipeline. Het resultaat is een productieklare testopzet en een advies over knelpunten en capaciteit.
 Past bij: Software Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure.

2. Kleine AI-agents voor de business (Data / AI engineering) 
In deze opdracht werk je als interne consultant binnen één afdeling, bijvoorbeeld Logistiek. Je spreekt gebruikers, brengt hun processen en knelpunten in kaart en bepaalt waar AI het meeste oplevert. Daarna bouw je één of meer kleine AI-agents op basis van de services en data die we al hebben. Je test ze en verbetert ze tot ze echt gebruikt worden in het dagelijkse werk.
 Past bij: AI, Data Science, Business IT, Software Engineering, als je graag dicht op eindgebruikers werkt.

3. Realtime monitoring & bottleneck-analyse voor Thinkwise-applicaties (Engineering) 
Verschillende kernapplicaties draaien op het low-code platform Thinkwise. Als gebruikers traagheid melden, kost het nu weken om de oorzaak te vinden. In deze opdracht bouw je monitoring die de performance over de hele stack realtime inzichtelijk maakt: van UI en applicatielaag tot database en netwerk. Die performance komt live op een scherm op de werkvloer van onze developers. Daarnaast ontwikkel je rapportage- en analysetooling waarmee developers bottlenecks precies kunnen aanwijzen en oplossen waar ze ontstaan. Zo vinden we problemen in uren in plaats van weken.
 Past bij: Software Engineering, Infrastructure, DevOps, met interesse in performance en observability.

4. Problem management & ITSM-procesoptimalisatie (System & Application Management) 
Onze Servicedesk en het S&AM-team krijgen veel meldingen binnen in Jira. Terugkerende problemen worden nog te weinig bij de bron opgelost. In deze opdracht breng je de ITSM-processen in kaart en leg je ze vast: processtromen, werkinstructies en rollen. Je toetst ze aan good practices zoals ITIL. Daarna ontwerp en implementeer je problem management als een vast proces, zodat terugkerende issues structureel verdwijnen.

jobs.title: Analytical Chemistry Specialist - Freelance AI Trainer Project
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Analytical Chemistry Specialist – Freelance AI Trainer Project based in Netherlands.

Are you an analytical chemistry expert interested in contributing to the next generation of artificial intelligence? This freelance opportunity allows you to apply your scientific expertise to train and evaluate advanced AI models designed to support scientific discovery, education, and laboratory research. You will assess AI-generated responses to complex analytical chemistry questions, identify inaccuracies, and strengthen scientific reasoning across a wide range of applications. Your work will help improve the accuracy, reliability, and practical relevance of AI-generated scientific knowledge. Working remotely and independently, you will contribute specialized insights to the development of more capable and trustworthy AI systems. This role is ideal for experienced chemistry professionals who enjoy solving complex problems, communicating scientific concepts, and exploring the intersection of chemistry and emerging technology.

Accountabilities

Evaluate AI-generated scientific content:  Review responses to theoretical and practical analytical chemistry questions, assessing their factual accuracy, logical consistency, scientific rigor, and relevance to real-world laboratory applications.

Apply specialized analytical chemistry knowledge:  Develop and evaluate scenarios involving spectroscopy, chromatography, electrochemical analysis, quantitative chemical analysis, environmental testing, pharmaceutical analysis, and analytical method development.

Assess advanced analytical techniques:  Challenge AI models on mass spectrometry, high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC), gas chromatography (GC), nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) interpretation, trace analysis, titrimetric methods, and related instrumentation.

Identify and document model weaknesses:  Record reproducible errors, reasoning gaps, inaccurate interpretations, and other failure patterns to support systematic improvements in model performance.

Contribute to AI training and evaluation:  Provide detailed scientific feedback, propose corrections, and recommend improvements to prompts, evaluation criteria, and testing methodologies.

Support scientific quality assurance:  Apply principles of method validation, quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC), and analytical data interpretation to evaluate the reliability of AI-generated outputs.

Communicate scientific reasoning clearly:  Explain conclusions, demonstrate analytical approaches, and document the steps behind technical judgments to help improve model transparency and reliability.

Requirements

Education:  A PhD in analytical chemistry or a closely related chemical science discipline is preferred. Equivalent advanced expertise supported by relevant professional or research experience may also be valuable.

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

The Observability team owns the monitoring and telemetry infrastructure that every engineer and researcher at Anthropic depends on—from metrics and logging pipelines to distributed tracing, profiling, error analytics, alerting, and the dashboards and query interfaces that make it all actionable. About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects.

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude.

In short , we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution.

Black Semiconductor GmbH is looking for an SAP S/4HANA Key User, who act as the central interface between business stakeholders and external SAP consultants, ensuring that business requirements are effectively translated into system solutions. Coordinate and manage change requests, system improvements, and minor configuration adjustments in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.

Create and maintain documentation of system configurations, business processes, test results, and customizations.

Degree in Business Informatics, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a comparable qualification.

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.  Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.  Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.  We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The opportunity  We are looking for a highly-motivated and driven platform engineer, with experience in enabling a DevOps culture within tech teams. In this role, your primary responsibility will be to provide a world-class developer experience to other engineers. You will have the autonomy to build solutions for the fascinating problems that we have to solve, allowing our customers (the software engineers) to build products quickly, securely, and to a high standard of quality.

What you'll do

Every day is different, but here’s an example of the kind of things you’ll work on:

Designing and implementing high quality infrastructure as code templates/modules, and empowering software engineers to use them for their projects.

Implementing AWS multi-account core infrastructure, and ensuring security best practices are being used across the cloud estate.

Authoring CI/CD templates and optimisations to ensure that engineers can release as early and often as possible.

Designing and implementing a developer portal, to provide a service catalog to the engineering team, and also author many other useful DevOps plugins.

Contributing to observability best practices and providing key SLI/SLO metric reporting, so that the engineering team can balance velocity and reliability.

Develop inner/open source projects to help provide a world-class developer experience to the engineering team.

About You  This role will be a great fit if you have:

Good working knowledge of AWS services including ECS, EC2, Lambda, VPC, IAM, Route53, CloudFront, S3, RDS

Good understanding of monitoring and logging solutions. We use OpenTelemetry, AWS Cloudwatch and SigNoz so experience with them is a bonus.

Basic SRE knowledge, and experience in alerting and incident management platforms (eg.  incident.io , Pagerduty)

Proven ability to provide and support strong and scalable CI/CD pipelines

Linux, Git, Docker and good scripting skills in e.g. Python, bash, Go. You should be proficient in at least one modern programming language.

Good experience in defining Infrastructure as Code using Terraform.

Join us during a pivotal growth phase and help create the foundations of a team that will drive meaningful transformation across the organisation.

You will independently lead complex projects with senior stakeholders across departments, and you will be the person we turn to when a project has drifted off course and needs to be brought back on track.

This is a delivery role first, and it is also a chance to shape how project management works in a growing, international company: you will contribute to our standards and methods, support colleagues who run their own projects and help build a project management community across our sites. As the team grows, so does the scope of what you can take on.

Your Mission

Project Leadership – Lead large, cross-functional projects independently from initiation to closure, including planning, governance, steering committees and stakeholder management.

Problem Solving - Facilitate and actively participate in problem-solving sessions to drive project success

Project Recovery – Take over projects that have drifted off course or lost their lead, diagnose what went wrong and re-establish structure as interim or permanent lead.

Stakeholder Management – Navigate demanding situations with senior leadership and across departments and prepare well-founded decisions for steering committees.

Quality and Coaching – Support department-led projects as quality assurance and sparring partner and coach project managers on their deliverables.

Standards and Methods – Contribute to our project management standards, templates and training formats, and turn project experience into reusable methods.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

Several years of experience independently leading complex, cross-functional projects with full ownership from initiation to closure.

Experience working with senior stakeholders and navigating conflicting interests across departments.

Strong analytical and problem solving skills.

Experience taking over or stabilising projects already in progress.

Ability to work independently, propose solutions and make decisions within your remit.

Business-level communication skills in German and English (C1).

Experience in applying common project management tools, e.g. for task and milestone tracking.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with an ERP or comparable large-scale system implementation.

IPMA Level C or equivalent. A higher level is a plus.

Experience in a manufacturing or regulated production environment.

Experience developing project management standards, templates or training formats.

Experience with Jira and Confluence.

Experience working in an international, multi-site organisation

jobs.description:
The Role That We Need:

PadSplit  is hiring for an Account Executive to expand our marketplace by engaging traditional property owners to become PadSplit Hosts. This role is critical in helping homeowners unlock additional income by listing their properties, while addressing housing affordability by creating more shared housing opportunities in the Chicago, Illinois market.

The Person We Are Looking For:

We are seeking a driven and personable Account Executive with experience in sales or real estate who excels at building relationships with property owners and real estate investors. This role involves delivering a tailored value pitch on how the PadSplit model and technology consistently drive superior rental income compared to traditional single-family rentals. The ideal candidate thrives in a remote environment, demonstrates strong communication skills, and wants to have an impact on the affordable housing crisis - one room at a time.

Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day:

Prospect and Qualify Leads:  Research and identify potential property owners who might be interested in becoming PadSplit Hosts and qualify them based on suitability.

Conduct Outreach:  Execute outreach strategies, including cold calling, emailing, and networking, to connect with traditional property owners.

Host Discovery Calls and Meetings:  Engage property owners in initial conversations to understand their needs, goals, and potential barriers to joining PadSplit.

Deliver Value Propositions : Clearly articulate the benefits of PadSplit's model, such as increased revenue potential, simplified management, and societal impact.

Build and Nurture Relationships:  Develop trust-based relationships with property owners, acting as a trusted advisor to address concerns and highlight opportunities.

Tailor Solutions:  Customize hosting solutions based on the unique circumstances of property owners, including financial modeling, property suitability, and compliance requirements.

Close Deals:  Guide property owners through the decision-making process, negotiate terms, and finalize agreements for onboarding as PadSplit Hosts.

Collaborate with Onboarding Teams:  Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth onboarding for new Hosts, providing accurate property details and expectations.

Track and Report Metrics:  Maintain detailed records in CRM systems, tracking outreach activities, conversion rates, and other key performance indicators.

Stay Updated on Market Trends:  Monitor the real estate market, competitive landscape, and legislative changes to refine outreach and value propositions effectively.

Host Educational Sessions:  Organize webinars or in-person sessions to educate property owners on PadSplit’s benefits and address common misconceptions.

Here’s what you’ll need to be successful:

Sales Experience:  Proven success in B2B or B2C sales, particularly in the real estate or property management sectors, with a track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.

The QA Automation Team is the ultimate guardian of our platform’s reliability, scalability, and deployment velocity. In a complex, data-heavy ecosystem, manual testing is a bottleneck; continuous, intelligent, and bulletproof automation is the only way forward.

We are looking for a  QA Automation Lead  who will architect, scale, and own our automated testing strategy end-to-end. You are not a passive test-case writer or a mere script executor; you are a highly technical, proactive engineer who thrives on breaking complex distributed systems, designing robust testing frameworks, and enforcing a culture of absolute quality. You will lead a dedicated team of automation engineers, embed quality gates directly into our CI/CD pipelines, and use data-driven metrics to eliminate regressions before they ever reach production.

End-to-End Testing Infrastructure:  Design, scale, and maintain robust automation frameworks capable of testing the complex SaaS and distributed data architectures of the  Actian  Data Intelligence Platform.

Pipeline Integration:  Embed automated test suites seamlessly into the CI/CD pipeline (GitHub Actions/Jenkins) to achieve true continuous integration and rapid feedback loops.

Advanced Testing Topologies:  Move beyond basic UI testing. Drive deep integration, API, performance, resilience, and data-integrity automation across the entire product stack.

Technical Anchor:  Act as the ultimate technical authority for the QA automation squad, establishing clean code standards for test scripts, conducting rigorous code reviews, and minimizing framework technical debt.

Upskilling & Accountability:  Coach junior automation engineers and guide functional QA testers in transitioning toward automated practices, ensuring everyone owns their automation targets.

Resource Optimization:  Allocate engineering capacity effectively across feature testing, framework enhancement, and technical debt reduction.

Release Gatekeeper:  Own the final quality sign-off for platform releases. Have the technical authority and conviction to halt deployments if quality thresholds are not met.

Cross-Functional Bridge:  Collaborate closely with Product Management, Core Engineering, and DevOps to understand new features early, mapping out automation strategies  before  the code is written.
