2K is headquartered in Novato, California and is a wholly owned label of Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (NASDAQ: TTWO). Founded in 2005, 2K Games is a global video game company, publishing titles developed by some of the most influential game development studios in the world. Our studios responsible for developing 2K’s portfolio of world-class games across multiple platforms, include Visual Concepts, Firaxis, Hangar 13, CatDaddy, Cloud Chamber, 31st Union, HB Studios, and 2K SportsLab. Our portfolio of titles is expanding due to our global strategic plan, building and acquiring exciting studios whose content continues to inspire all of us! 2K publishes titles in today’s most popular gaming genres, including sports, shooters, action, role-playing, strategy, casual, and family entertainment.

Our team of engineers, marketers, artists, writers, data scientists, producers, thinkers and doers, are the professional publishing stewards of 2K’s portfolio currently includes several AAA, sports and entertainment brands, including global powerhouse NBA®️ 2K, renowned BioShock®️, Borderlands®️, Mafia, Sid Meier’s Civilization®️ and XCOM®️ brands; popular WWE®️ 2K and WWE®️ SuperCard franchises, TopSpin 2K25, as well as the critically and commercially acclaimed PGA TOUR®️ 2K

At 2K, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment, which means encouraging our teams to Come as You Are and do your best work! We encourage ALL applicants to explore our global positions, even if they don’t meet every requirement for the role. If you're interested in the job and think you have what it takes to work at 2K, we encourage you to apply!

What We Need

We’re looking for a passionate Senior Data Analyst to support the WWE & PGAT Game Science & Insights team, to explore, analyze, report, and action on data from our portfolio of titles (WWE 2K, PGA TOUR 2K). We’re looking for someone who can translate product & business knowledge into deep analysis and, in turn, translate to actionable insights for cross functional business stakeholders. As you deliver valuable insights to stakeholders, you will aim to build strong relationships, become a trusted partner among business functions, and scale out team efforts from one team to the next. Our mission is to enable our partners to be more proactive, productive & successful by providing best in class, end-to-end and scalable data solutions.

What You Will Do

  • Leverage a deep understanding of how our titles’ game features & mechanics work and our business priorities to deliver actionable, business-impacting insights
  • Support business narratives and develop business cases with effective data storytelling. Focus on using data and hypothesis-driven decision-making to drive future growth and customer lifetime value
  • Learn different business teams’ and stakeholders’ ways

jobs.title: Recruiter, GTM
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is growing quickly across EMEA, and we need recruiters who can help us hire exceptional people into the teams that bring our work to customers. We’re looking for a Recruiter, GTM to join our Talent team in Dublin and own full-cycle recruiting across our Go-To-Market organization, with a particular focus on Applied AI.

This is a full-cycle individual-contributor role. You’ll partner with Applied AI and GTM leaders to define what great looks like, build pipelines in markets where these roles are still new, and close candidates who have competing offers. Some of the roles you’ll run won’t have an established market benchmark, so you’ll help build the playbook as well as follow it. Priorities shift quickly, and you’ll have real ownership of the searches you run.

Key responsibilities

  • Own full-cycle recruiting for Applied AI and broader GTM roles across EMEA, with a focus on London, Paris and Munich, from intake through offer and close
  • Run intake sessions that scope the role, calibrate the bar, and challenge hiring managers where expectations don’t match the market
  • Screen candidates against the JD with enough technical judgment to separate strong from merely well-presented
  • Source and engage active and passive candidates, building diverse and competitive pipelines in markets where talent is scarce
  • Run structured, rigorous and candidate-centric interview processes that uphold Anthropic’s hiring bar
  • Work with the broader Talent team, People Partners and Compensation to structure offers and guide candidates to close
  • Own pipeline health, tracking conversion, calibration and time-in-stage, and use the data to give hiring managers clear recommendations
  • Help build and document the Applied AI and GTM hiring playbooks as the team scales

Minimum qualifications

  • 4+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, with a track record of closing strong candidates in competitive markets
  • Demonstrated experience recruiting GTM or customer-facing roles in the UK and European markets, with working knowledge of local talent dynamics, compensation norms and employment practices
  • Strong stakeholder partnership: you build trust quickly with senior hiring managers in fast-moving environments
  • Willingness and ability to build technical depth quickly enough to run credible intake sessions and screens for Applied AI roles
  • Proven ability to maintain quality under volume pressure and manage multiple sear

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
About  Customer.io

Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day.  Customer.io  powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.

About the role

Hi, my name is Lauren, Senior Manager of Customer Success at  Customer.io , and I'm looking for a Customer Success Manager to join our Mid-Market, APAC or EMEA team.

You'll own the success of a dedicated portfolio of roughly 40-60 Mid-Market customers — acting as their strategic advisor from onboarding through long-term adoption, and driving commercial outcomes across your book of business. You'll partner closely with Account Management, Technical Support, Product, Solutions, and Engineering to help customers realize real value throughout their lifecycle.

We don't need you to be a marketing expert or a deeply technical one. We need someone who's an expert at asking the right questions — someone who digs until they find the real problem, not just the reported one, and who can influence a customer to make progress and move through blockers. You'll be curious and eager to understand our app well enough to take a customer's use case and turn our features into outcomes that matter to them.

What we value

Curiosity about the business behind the customer:  You're genuinely interested in how companies operate and enjoy learning your customers' industries and goals. You ask about the  why  behind a request before recommending a solution.

Trusted advisor, not ticket-taker:  You build relationships that turn you into a strategic partner rather than someone who simply answers questions. You have well-formed opinions about customer experience and aren't shy about sharing them.

Ownership of commercial outcomes:  You see CS as a value and growth engine. You take ownership of outcomes across your book and naturally look for opportunities to create more value, partnering with AM on retention and expansion.

Comfort in ambiguity:  You thrive on complex, open-ended customer challenges — bringing together business context, technical understanding, and creativity to solve them. You're calm under pressure, highly organized, and able to juggle competing priorities across a full portfolio.

AI-forward thinking:  You're comfortable using AI tools to improve your own productivity and your customers' outcomes, and you bring a growth mindset toward experimenting with new AI-powered ways of working.

What you'll do

Manage a dedicated portfolio of ~40-60 Mid-Market customers as their strategic partner across the full customer lifecycle

Lead onboarding — running kickoffs and milestone check-ins, and guiding customers to their first measurable outcomes

Build a deep understanding of each customer's goals and translate them into measurable, mutual success plans

jobs.description:
우리는 게이머의 로망을 실현하기 위해, 누구도 가지 않는 길을 갑니다.
예상을 뛰어넘는 과감한 상상력과 기술로, 전 세계 팬들이 잊지 못할 세상을 만들기 위해 담대하게 도전하고 개척합니다.

We pioneer the path to players' dreams.
With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

"AI First 크래프톤을 완성하는 데이터의 심장,"

크래프톤 AX(AI Transformation)는 전사에 AI를 도입하여, 데이터와 인프라를 기반으로 임직원들의 워크(Work)와 워크플로우(Workflow) 자동화를 가속화하고 그 압도적인 효율화 성과를 전사로 확산하는 핵심 조직입니다.
Data Foundation 팀은 파편화된 전사 데이터를 통합하고, AI(LLM, AI Agent 등)가 즉각적으로 이해하고 활용할 수 있는 최적의 데이터 구조(Ontology)와 아키텍처를 설계·구축합니다.
크래프톤의 각 조직이 실제로 사용하는 데이터와 업무 맥락을 깊이 이해하고, 이를 AI가 이해할 수 있는 데이터 관리·활용 체계로 직접 기획하고 설계해 낼 분을 모십니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

담당 도메인의 데이터 관리·활용 체계를 직접 기획·설계하고, 설계 산출물(Ontology 설계서, 데이터 모델, 거버넌스 기준 문서 등)을 주도적으로 작성·관리합니다.

  • 도메인별 데이터 구조 분석 및 Ontology 설계: 도메인의 원천 데이터와 업무 프로세스를 분석하고, AI(LLM, AI Agent)가 활용할 수 있는 Ontology(개체·관계·속성 정의) 구조를 주도적으로 설계하며 Ontology 설계서를 작성·관리
  • 비즈니스 용어·지표 정의 및 데이터 거버넌스 기준 수립: 도메인별 핵심 용어(Glossary), 지표 정의, 데이터 오너십·접근 권한 기준을 현업과 협의해 수립하고 거버넌스 기준 문서로 정립
  • 데이터 품질·정합성 분석 및 개선: 원천 데이터의 정합성, 완결성, 중복 여부를 분석하고, 개선 방안을 직접 도출해 Ontology 설계 및 데이터 구축에 반영
  • 현업 부서와의 요구사항 분석 및 데이터 모델링: 담당 조직의 실무자를 인터뷰하고 업무 데이터를 분석하여, 실제 질의·분석 시나리오에 맞는 데이터 모델(테이블 구조, 관계, 계층)을 설계·구축하고 지속적으로 개선

이런 경험을 가진 분과 함께 성장하고 싶습니다! (필수요건)

  • 데이터 분석, BI, 또는 데이터 모델링 관련 분야 7년 이상의 경력을 보유하신 분 (데이터 엔지니어링뿐 아니라 데이터 분석가 경력도 포함)
  • SQL을 능숙하게 다루며, 원천 데이터를 스스로 탐색·분석해 구조를 파악할 수 있는 분
  • 특정 업무 도메인의 데이터와 프로세스를 깊이 이해하고, 현업과 커뮤니케이션하며 요구사항을 구조화해 데이터 모델·지표 체계로 설계해 온 경험이 있는 분
  • 데이터 모델링(테이블 설계, 정규화, 관계 정의 등)을 직접 기획·수행해 본 경험이 있으신 분
  • 새로운 개념(Ontology, Semantic Layer 등)을 빠르게 학습하고 실무에 적용하려는 의지가 강하신 분

jobs.title: Senior Computational Geometry Engineer
jobs.description:
SAEKI - Manufacturing at software speed  Europe's defense industrial base cannot respond at the speed modern conflict requires. Legacy suppliers operate on month-long timelines. Tribal knowledge is retiring. Supply chains are fragile. SAEKI is building the operating system for autonomous factories - the infrastructure that lets Europe manufacture mission-critical components at software speed.

The Role  As a Computational Geometry Engineer, you own the geometry core of our Manufacturing Intelligence stack - the engine that takes an arbitrary customer CAD model and reasons about how to build it, and then proves that we built it right.
You own the code that runs in the factory.

What We're Looking For

5+ years  building geometry-heavy software in production - CAD/CAM, geometry kernels, feature recognition, CAE/simulation preparation, metrology, or comparable.

B-rep and Mesh Depth . You think natively in topology and NURBS. Feature recognition, defeaturing, robust booleans, offsetting, surface/surface intersection, healing and repair. You know exactly why floating-point robustness destroys naive implementations - and what to do about it. You have had the opportunity to delve into complex CAD models and are able to assess their quality in both quantitative and qualitative terms (gaps in edge, spikes in loops, tiny elements, twisted surfaces...) and ultimately predict which types of processing might be challenged.

Kernel Fluency . Hands-on with a geometry kernel - Parasolid, OpenCASCADE, ACIS, or equivalent - and the judgment to know which parts can be developed in-house in order to retain full control and IP rights, and which parts too complex (e.g. advanced solvers) should be integrated as 3rd parties. Comfortable with mesh and point-cloud processing (libigl, Open3D, CGAL, PCL) alongside solid modelling.You know well STEP file format and about integration into collaboration & interoperability processes.

Technical Excellence . Strong command of modern C++ (17+), plus Python for rapid iteration. Rust is welcome. You write and test performant code.

Manufacturing Instinct . Some knowledge of fabrication techniques-casting, stamping, composites, and additive manufacturing-alongside toolsets for evaluating design manufacturability, risk profiles, quality standards, and cost factors.

End-to-End Ownership . Algorithm design through to a shipped, tested, maintained service.

First Principles Thinker.  You reason by physics and mathematics, not analogy. When an algorithm fails on a real part, you know whether the bug is in the code, the model, or the assumption.

Industrial Grit . You want to stand next to the machine in Germany and watch your output run. The feedback loop between your code and cutting metal is the point.

Maniacal Urgency . Speed is our only edge. You thrive in the "chaos-to-order" phase of a startup.

We work on building embeddings to understand content and users' interests based on the content they engage with.

Our team has the potential to highlight one of Reddit's biggest differentiators: genuinely curated, high-quality, extremely relevant, and daily updated organic content. We are a Machine Learning/Data heavy team with a focus on the following areas:

Knowledge Graph Embeddings -  Building representations for the Knowledge graph entities, e.g., intellectual properties/brands, to be used for high-precision targeting & business insights.

User Intent Modeling -  Leveraging various techniques to introduce user representations based on the content they interact with: batch & real-time sequence modeling, LLM summarization, etc.

LLM-based Representations  - Leveraging LLMs, VLMs, and foundational models to build complex representations of Reddit entities that improve ranking outcomes

The signals and features we create become a key piece in the Ads Delivery funnel, from targeting to the auction, as well as the Business Insights product and other advertiser-facing products such as Creative generation and optimization.

entire

We're taking  autonomous search  mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses.

We're designing the future of  autonomous marketing , taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer-first work marketers were always meant to do.

And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine —  Loomi  — so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora.

You'd be joining the  Artificial Intelligence team . We own the algorithmic core of the platform: Predictions, Contextual Personalization, contextual bandits, autosegmentation, and the agentic workflows behind Loomi. We work with behavioural data at terabyte scale, across 1,400+ customers, in production, every day. We are currently allowing flexibility for our employees to work from anywhere for the respective region  (Central & Eastern Europe)  or we are happy to  meet you in our offices in Bratislava (Slovakia) or Brno, Prague (Czechia) on a full-time basis.

The mission

You find the signal in how 1,400 brands' customers actually behave — and you prove it moved a business metric.  Your models decide which customers are predicted to churn, which segments form themselves, which offer a shopper sees, and whether the discount changed anything or was going to convert anyway.

What you'll actually do

Frame the problem before modelling it.  Most of our highest-impact work arrives as a vague business question, and turning it into something measurable is the first job.

Work the data at scale.  Behavioural data, product catalogues and event streams across BigQuery and Databricks — finding features that carry real predictive signal, not the ones that are easy to compute.

Build and evaluate models  across Predictions and Contextual Personalization: propensity and churn, contextual bandits, autosegmentation, uplift and incrementality.

Design the evaluation, not just the model.  Offline metrics, backtests, and the A/B design that decides whether this ships. You own the question "how would we know if this is worse?"

Bring methods in from outside and judge them honestly  — read the literature, run the quick PoC, and tell a real result from a well-marketed one.

Hand off cleanly to ML Engineering.  You own the model and the evidence

As a Strategic Sourcer, you’ll be part of a new global sourcing hub focused on finding the right contributors for complex AI projects that require specialized or hard-to-reach talent across a wide range of domains, from translation and localization to legal, medical, scientific, and technical fields.

jobs.title: Talent Analyst Specialist (Fully Remote)
jobs.description:
Luxury Presence

is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

Talent Analyst Specialist

Remote (Philippines) | Reports to: VP of People

ABOUT THE ROLE

We hire fast, and we're getting bigger every quarter. That only works if the people making hiring decisions can see clearly. Which channels produce great candidates. Where offers stall. How headcount plans track against budget. What our employer brand actually says to the market.

This role builds that clarity. You'll stand up the talent analytics function from the ground up, set the data standards our hiring systems run on, and design the collateral that helps strong candidates say yes. It's part analyst, part systems owner, part brand builder, and you'll be the person leadership comes to when they want a real answer about hiring.

The work is hard for a good reason. Talent data lives across an ATS, an HRIS, sourcing tools, a finance model, and more spreadsheets than anyone wants to admit, and none of them fully agree with each other. You'll decide what good data looks like, get the organization to hold that standard, and turn it into reporting people actually open on a Monday morning. You'll also own the story we tell candidates, and you'll know whether that story is working because you'll be measuring it.

WHAT YOU’LL OWN

Talent Analytics

Build the talent analytics function at Luxury Presence, from metric definitions through to the dashboards recruiters and leaders use every week

Define the talent KPIs that matter, including time to fill, pipeline conversion, source quality, offer acceptance, and quality of hire, and set the targets we hold ourselves to

Automate reporting so it refreshes itself and nobody spends Friday rebuilding a deck by hand

Bring analysis to leadership with a recommendation attached, not just a chart

Data Governance

Develop and implement data quality standards across the full talent tool stack

Own field definitions, required data, and naming conventions, then run the audits that keep them honest

Partner with the teams who own our systems and integrations to close gaps at the source rather than patching them downstream

Make our talent data trustworthy enough that Finance and leadership plan from it without checking it twice

Workforce Planning

Partner with Finance to track and forecast headcount, and keep one source of truth for approved, open, and filled roles

Build the workforce analytics that connect hiring activity to plan, budget, and capacity

Surface variances early, with enough context for leaders to act on them

Employer Brand and Talent Collateral

Manage the full lifecycle of our employer branding assets, from creation through refresh and retirement

Our chef-crafted, science-backed Mains and functional Drizzles are designed to support lifelong health. We’re building a brand for people whose dogs are family, grounded in the care that goes into their food and the pleasure of the life they share.

This is a highly hands-on role. You’ll move between setting brand strategy and shaping the work itself: developing concepts, directing shoots, reviewing packaging proofs, refining copy, and helping the team get projects out into the world.

With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. In this role, you will lead the architecture, modeling, and execution of our global compensation programs while leveraging modern AI platforms and scalable data pipelines.

As a Staff level technical authority, you will drive business-critical compensation initiatives—from merit cycles and pay modeling to global equity strategy. Strategic Compensation Analytics & AI-Assisted Modeling

jobs.title: Creative Director
jobs.description:
About NVE:

NVE Experience Agency  is a brand experience and production agency dedicated to building ideas rooted in culture and guided by the principle that  “The Right Moment Will Transform Someone Forever.”  NVE’s team of creatives, strategists, and producers develop insight-driven ideas that convert consumer attention into commitment, action, and brand loyalty.

Summary of Position:

As a Creative Director at NVE, you’ll help lead the creative team in developing innovative concepts and executing groundbreaking experiences and campaigns. For this role, we are seeking a Creative Director who has a deep passion for fandom and is seasoned in bringing themed and immersive experiences to life. You are a storyteller and a world builder at heart and understand the theatrical craft it takes to deliver buzzworthy experiences for true fans.

Job Responsibilities:

Lead the development of big, bold, breakthrough ideas for brand experiences and campaigns – the kind of work that people talk about

Own mid to large-sized projects independently and oversee all aspects of creative — concept, storytelling and design

Oversee the execution of projects from initial idea to final delivery, ensuring ideas are as magical in execution as they were in concept

Present creative ideas and campaigns to clients, building trust and enthusiasm for the vision

Manage and mentor a team of art directors, copywriters, and other creatives, fostering professional growth

Identify opportunities to innovate and push creative boundaries within the agency and client work

Stay informed about industry trends, tools, and technologies to maintain NVE’s competitive edge

Manage resources, budgets, and timelines and work closely with creative leadership to cast the right teams

Provide constructive but direct feedback to ensure the highest quality of creative output and be an active advocate for building and cultivating creative culture

Be comfortable using industry-leading AI tools to accelerate and enhance the creative process and be a constant student of innovation

Cultivate a collaborative, high-performing team culture that emphasizes creativity and inclusion

Qualifications:

You have a portfolio with work people recognize because it’s that good – you have award-winning and press-getting work in it

You embody NVE’s behaviors – be courageous, be committed, be curious, be catalysts, and be good citizens

You are a marketer with ideally a decade plus of experience and at least several years experience managing people and teams

You are confident, passionate and have a POV, but not an ego – you know that this work takes teamwork

jobs.title: Legal AI Engineer (Zurich)

Description

Legartis is on a mission: to unlock legal work at scale.  We set the standard for AI-powered contract work by offering a platform that changes how legal teams work, from drafting through negotiation to completion. We are now looking for the person who turns what customers actually need into what our AI actually does.  Joining Legartis is not taking a job, you take ownership. We are a team of product builders and lawyers, who do not chase hype; we build substance. If you are a lawyer who builds, someone who has stopped waiting for better tools and started making them, this is your moment and your place.  Send us your CV, a short note on why Legartis, and links to anything you have built or published.

Your mission

Most companies split this seat across three teams, and that split is exactly the problem. The person who hears the customer describe their workflow should be the person who writes the requirement, and the person who writes the requirement should be able to build the first version themselves. That is you.

1. You translate customer reality into engineering requirements — and into revenue.  You sit in customer and expert calls alongside Sales, not as a note-taker but as the person who understands the legal work. Build systems that keep eval results reproducible and comparable over time, as models, benchmarks and code evolve.

Run evaluations at scale across our GPU clusters, from model serving to scoring.

Make eval results easy to access, explore and trust, through APIs and dashboards that researchers use every day.

Master's or PhD in Computer Science, or equivalent experience.

4+ years building production-grade software, ideally large-scale ML codebases or distributed systems.

Excellent Python and strong software-design instincts: testing, code review, CI/CD.

Experience running workloads on GPU clusters (Slurm, Kubernetes, Ray or similar).

Familiarity with LLM inference and evaluation.

Self-starter, low-ego, collaborative.

Experience building or maintaining evaluation harnesses or benchmarks.

Hands-on experience with inference engines such as vLLM or SGLang.

Experience with agentic or RL environments.

Open-source contributions to ML tooling.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, SEO and AI Visibility - US
jobs.description:
Luxury Presence

is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

Role Overview

We're looking for a  Staff Product Manager  to own the  SEO and AI visibility  solutions we build for our clients: more than 20,000 real estate websites that rank independently, each in its own market, with its own authority, its own competitors, and a real business depending on the outcome. This is not the SEO of a single corporate domain or one large marketplace. It is a platform product, where one change to a template, a schema implementation, or the way we render content moves thousands of domains at once.

The mandate is an excellent organic discovery platform: technical foundations, page experience, conversion, content, measurement, migrations, and experimentation. AI search is a growing part of that. Our clients are evaluated by Google's AI Overviews and AI Mode, by ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini, and by every prospective seller who asks an assistant which agent they should call. The best people in this job design for three constituencies at once: the people who visit these sites, the crawlers and AI agents that read them, and the real estate business whose revenue depends on both.

This is not a job for someone who runs audits and hands recommendations to other people. You will set the strategy, ship with your own engineering team, and build the defaults, standards, and safeguards that make quality hold across the entire fleet. Most real estate professionals will never hire a technical SEO of their own. Our platform is how they get one.

What You'll Do

Own the product strategy and roadmap for organic discovery and AI visibility across every site on the platform, including what clients can see, control, and get credit for

Own the technical foundations across every page type we generate: crawlability, indexation, rendering, internal linking, structured data, and page performance

Productize what repeats. When the same issue or workflow shows up across the fleet, solve it once through better defaults, automation, shared capabilities, or safeguards

Make our clients' brands, listings, and expertise legible to AI assistants, and define how we measure citations and visibility across answer engines

Run a real experimentation program: prove changes on representative cohorts of sites, establish incremental impact, then scale what works rather than shipping broadly and inferring impact afterward

Own migration quality and regression prevention, including the standards, acceptance criteria, and automated checks that hold search quality as the platform ships

Partner with the team building the next generation of our website platform so search is designed in from the start,

Prioritize feature requests across customers, vertical product area

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Growth at Anthropic is about helping people discover what Claude can do and make it part of how they work, from someone's first session to an entire company rolling out Claude. We're a small design team working across all of Anthropic's products, on problems that often don't have established playbooks, because the products and the capabilities behind them change so quickly.

We drive growth by making the product itself better, favoring foundational changes and new product experiences over small optimizations. Our focus spans whatever most limits Anthropic's growth, and priorities can shift quickly.

As a senior Product Designer on Growth, you'll own how Claude grows with people who use it for their everyday work. You'll dig into why some people make Claude a habit and others don't, find the real bottlenecks, and lead the product changes that move them. You'll set the vision for this area, partner closely with product, engineering, and data science, and raise the quality bar for the designers around you.

We're looking for designers who thrive in ambiguity and pair sharp diagnostic judgment with exceptional craft. Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

Discord's Enterprise Technology org is building a software engineering discipline from the ground up, and this is the founding engineering hire. There is no Enterprise Platform team yet. You will not be maintaining a status quo or joining an existing backlog: you will define the discipline, set the technical foundation, and build the platform that lets the internal systems enabling Discordians scale with the company.

Discord's mission is to cultivate belonging, and doing that at scale requires internal systems that move as fast as the product itself. The mission of this role is to turn our enterprise infrastructure into self-service software. Your job is to replace manual consoles and tickets with a platform of reusable primitives, building blocks like "provision a device" or "push an IAM policy or app integration through code," exposed through clean APIs and self-service portals. As a code-forward Staff engineer, you will design abstractions that hide the messy reality of Okta, Jamf, and Terraform (our identity, device management, and infrastructure-as-code tools) behind interfaces people actually want to use, operating with a platform-as-a-product mindset.

What You'll Do

  • Set the foundation: Define the technical direction and architecture for the discipline, writing the RFCs and documentation that future hires will build on.

About ElevenLabs  ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.  We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

High-velocity:  Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

Impact not job titles:  We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

AI first:  We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

Excellence everywhere:  Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

Global team:  We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

Innovative culture:  You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

Growth paths:  Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

Annual company offsite:  Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

The ElevenLabs Impact Program exists to democratize access to our technology and make AI work for all people, supporting for-good use cases across healthcare, education, and culture. Today, some of our work includes providing free and discounted access to nonprofits, partnering with university professors to bring voice AI into the classroom and the research lab

jobs.title: Principal, Growth Lead - League of Legends
jobs.description:
We're looking for a strategic, player-obsessed Growth Lead to help grow League of Legends. As a Principal Growth Lead, you'll partner closely with Brand Marketing, Publishing, Product, Lifecycle Marketing, Performance Marketing, and external platform partners to ensure our biggest publishing moments reach our growth audiences in addition to our loyal fans.

You will be responsible for developing growth strategies that complement publishing strategy and brand marketing by identifying high-value player segments, uncovering actionable insights, and translating those insights into targeted marketing programs across Riot's growth channels. Rather than leading the overall campaign strategy, you'll amplify it—ensuring the right audiences receive the right message through the right channels to maximize acquisition, engagement, retention, and reactivation.

Success in this role requires equal parts strategic thinking and operational excellence. You'll thrive in ambiguity, develop insights where they don't yet exist, understand the capabilities and limitations of modern marketing technology, and build executable plans that drive measurable business impact. You'll continuously evaluate campaign performance, identify new growth opportunities, and help evolve Riot's publishing capabilities through experimentation and learning.

If you're passionate about combining player understanding, data, marketing technology, and creative execution to solve complex growth challenges, we'd love to have you help shape the future of League of Legends.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Partner with game publishing teams to develop growth marketing strategies that extend and amplify integrated marketing campaigns.
  • Identify underserved or strategically important player audiences and develop targeted approaches to acquire, engage, retain, and reactivate those players throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Build audience growth strategies grounded in player insights, behavioral data, experimentation, and market understanding, especially in spaces where existing research is limited or incomplete.
  • Translate campaign objectives into channel-specific growth strategies and strategic briefs across Lifecycle Marketing, Performance Marketing, Paid Media, Platform Marketing, and other growth channels.
  • Lead cross-functional planning between Game Marketing, Lifecycle Marketing, Paid Media, CRM, Creative, Analytics, Data Science, and external partners to deliver coordinated growth campaigns.
  • Partner with game publishing teams to scope, brief, review, and deliver marketing assets optimized for growth channels while maintaining alignment with the game's broader marketing strategy.
  • Collaborate with external platform partners and managed-service media partners to identify incremental opportunities and execute high-impact campaigns.
  • Develop and optimize personalized player experiences across

jobs.title: Staff AI & Data Engineer, HR Systems
jobs.description:
Riot’s Enterprise Technology organization ensures Rioters have what they need to unlock their full potential, from secure and compliant systems to efficient business platforms that keep the company running smoothly. HR Tech & Systems builds and evolves the technology ecosystem that supports Rioters across the employee lifecycle.

As a Staff AI & Data Engineer, HR Systems, you will bring deep AI and modern data engineering expertise to HR Systems, accelerating our evolution into an AI-augmented and data-enabled engineering organization. You will be a hands-on builder who designs and delivers AI agents, intelligent automations, data products, and reusable engineering capabilities across Riot's HR Technology ecosystem.

You will combine strong AI and data engineering expertise with meaningful HR technology and domain knowledge. You will work across Workday, Databricks, and Riot's broader AI and enterprise technology ecosystem to turn trusted HR data and complex HR processes into secure, scalable solutions.

Just as importantly, you will help build these capabilities within the existing team. You will pair with HR Tech engineers, establish practical engineering patterns, and provide hands-on mentorship in AI, Databricks, and modern development practices so the team can increasingly design, build, and support these solutions independently.

You will partner closely with HR Tech & Systems, Enterprise Data & AI, Enterprise Software Engineering, HR COEs, and other Enterprise Technology teams.

The role reports to the Senior Manager, HR Tech & Systems.

Responsibilities:

HR Technology Engineering & Automation

  • Apply deep HR technology knowledge to discover opportunities and develop solutions across HR operations, recruiting, onboarding, compensation, benefits, learning, talent, workforce planning, and HR analytics.
  • Leverage Riot's evolving AI and automation ecosystem, including tools such as Workato, Windsurf, Devin, and TrueFoundry, to accelerate development and delivery.
  • Evaluate opportunities within HR Technology’s workflow and portfolio of applications, including SaaS and custom systems, to establish best practices and introduce new AI-enhanced capabilities.
  • Partner with HR stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to identify high-value opportunities and determine when AI, automation, data products, integrations, or native platform capabilities are the most appropriate solution.
  • Translate complex HR processes, policies, and operational needs into scalable technical solutions that improve Rioter experiences and business outcomes.
  • Drive solutions through the full lifecycle from discovery and prototyping through implementation, adoption, measurement, and continuous improvement.

AI & Agent Engineering

  • Design and build agentic AI solutions

jobs.title: Technical Producer II - VALORANT, Developer Experience
jobs.description:
As Technical Producers at Riot, we lead passionate technical teams to create products and experiences that maximize developer and player value. We guide development, clear blockers, and push projects across the finish line while helping our teams operate sustainably and maintain a collaborative environment.

As a Technical Producer on VALORANT’s Developer Experience & Workflows (DEW) team, you will own team-level production for the team that makes VALORANT’s development inner loop fast, reliable, and increasingly self-service. DEW supports the developer workflows used to create, validate, and iterate on VALORANT content and code, helping teams move efficiently toward playable, shippable work. These workflows include editor workflows, content versioning, leak detection, and VALORANT-specific asset guardrails.

You will partner closely with the DEW Product Lead and Engineering Manager to turn agreed upon direction into executable plans, establish a reliable operating rhythm, coordinate dependencies, manage delivery risk, and create clear visibility into commitments and outcomes. Product owns product direction and roadmap priorities. Engineering owns the technical approach and quality. Production owns planning, coordination, execution health, delivery visibility, and helping the team make and keep realistic commitments. This role reports to the Senior Manager, Technical Production for VALORANT Foundations.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead DEW’s day-to-day production practice, including planning, team rituals, commitments, risks, dependencies, and delivery visibility
  • Translate agreed product direction and technical plans into executable work, milestones, and release or transition plans
  • Maintain a clear execution backlog and capacity plan across KTLO, emergent support, planned work, and discretionary investment
  • Coordinate dependencies across DEW and partner teams, surface delivery risks early, and drive issues to clear owners and decisions
  • Partner with Product and Engineering on intake and tradeoffs, while communicating status, decisions, changes, and risks to stakeholders and customers
  • Improve DEW’s operating system and team sustainability using production and service health metrics, with the goal of making delivery more predictable and DEW workflows more reliable

Required Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of experience as a Producer, Product Manager, or Development Manager delivering technical tools, services, workflows, or complex software initiatives from planning through post-release support
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience with strong technical knowledge and problem-solving skills
  • Experience partnering with engineering leadership to clarify scope, manage dependencies, resolve risks, and deliver against commitments
  • Experience managing execution backlogs acro

jobs.title: Senior Brand Manager
jobs.description:
As a Senior Brand Manager on VALORANT, you will independently architect end-to-end global brand strategies, lead complex campaign planning, and provide high-level creative stewardship across marquee multi-platform publishing beats. While this role primarily anchors our core PC and Console campaign ecosystem (major Episode/Act beats, Agent launches, skinline moments, and competitive beats), you will also step in to lead or support marquee cross-platform initiatives including VALORANT Mobile in China, as well as cross-ecosystem beats.

You will operate with high autonomy—shaping full-year campaign roadmaps, setting strategic positioning, guiding matrixed teams, and continuously challenging creative partners to elevate work beyond status-quo norms.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Brand Strategy & Positioning: Define and drive end-to-end global campaign strategy, and player journey design for VALORANT’s major live-service, esports, and platform beats.
  • Gold-Standard Briefing & Creative Stewardship: Deliver decision-enabling, insight-driven campaign briefs. Partner directly with Creative, Production, and Craft leads, continuously challenging creative execution throughout production to maintain an elevated quality bar.
  • Cross-Functional & Regional Leadership: Guide matrixed cross-functional teams (Production, Comms, Social, Influencer, Growth, Dev, Esports) and steward Regional Brand Leads across global publishing hubs to ensure regional relevance alongside global campaign cohesion.
  • Measurement, Analysis & Optimization: Partner with Insights to establish campaign KPIs, evaluate post-campaign performance, and synthesize complex audience data into actionable learnings that inform future full-year publishing roadmaps.
  • Full-Year Campaign & Budget Management: Manage publishing budgets for owned workstreams, prioritize resources under ambiguity, and build full-year campaign roadmaps in alignment with game dev timelines.

Required Qualifications:

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in brand strategy, game publishing, or marketing within gaming or entertainment, with a proven track record of full, end-to-end campaign ownership.
  • PC & Console Ecosystem Focus: 3+ years directly engaging gaming audiences, with deep familiarity in live-service FPS, competitive shooters, or core PC/Console ecosystems.
  • Large-Scale Campaign Leadership: Demonstrated experience leading complex, integrated marketing campaigns involving product marketing, community, social, esports, and external agencies.
  • Strategic & Creative Rigor: Exceptional ability to write sharp, decision-enabling briefs and translate complex player insights into clear strategic direction.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager (Brand Partnerships)
jobs.description:
The Riot Commercial Partnerships (RCP) team is responsible for identifying, building, and executing world-class partnerships with leading global and regional brands. Our mission is to drive revenue through strategic commercial collaborations that bring meaningful value to Riot’s fans—across Games, Entertainment, Esports, and Social Impact. For every product and event Riot creates, our partners help elevate the experience for millions of players and audiences around the world.

We’re looking for a strategic, highly organized program manager to help scale how Riot develops, manages, and activates brand partnerships globally and regionally. Reporting to and in partnership with the Director, Partnership Management, this role will oversee the end-to-end operating process for regional brand partnership opportunities, working closely with Regional Riot Publishing & Partnerships Leads (RPPLs), Business Development (BD), and cross-functional stakeholders to move opportunities from identification and evaluation through deal development, execution, and reporting.

This role will serve as the central program leader connecting regional opportunities to Riot’s broader commercial strategy—creating clarity around priorities, establishing effective processes, driving accountability across teams, and providing leadership with visibility into the regional partnership pipeline and performance. In addition, this role will directly manage and activate select high-priority global brand partnerships and serve as the partnership lead for the Esports World Cup (EWC) relationship and other strategic co-marketing partnerships. Because priorities shift quickly in our fast-paced environment, this role includes—but isn’t limited to—the responsibilities below.

Responsibilities:

  • Oversee the regional brand partnership operating process, working in close partnership with regional RPPLs and BD teams, acting as the program lead with this group of key stakeholders who will identify, evaluate, prioritize, develop, and execute local and regional brand partnership opportunities.
  • Establish clear frameworks, workflows, milestones, and decision points that enable regional teams to pursue opportunities efficiently while maintaining alignment with Riot’s global partnership strategy and standards.
  • Serve as the central program manager across regional partnership opportunities, coordinating stakeholders, identifying dependencies, resolving blockers, and ensuring opportunities progress from initial concept through contracting, activation, and measurement.
  • Build and maintain a consolidated view of the regional brand partnership pipeline, providing regular reporting, insights, risks, and recommendations to RCP and senior leadership.
  • Partner with BD and regional teams to evaluate opportunities against commercial potential, player value, strategic fit, operational complexity, and broader Riot priorities.

jobs.title: Manager, Anti-Cheat Engineering (Head of PC Game Security) - Central Technology, Anti-Cheat
jobs.description:
Riot’s Anti-Cheat team is versatile and passionate about its craft. We understand the player impact of cheating in games and are focused on setting the highest bar for the integrity of multiplayer games. We relish the opportunity to work with low-level systems and take pride in developing creative, rigorous defenses against adversaries. At the most fundamental level, our goal is to promote the best player experience by protecting the legitimacy of their favorite games.

As a Manager, Anti-Cheat Engineering, you will lead the team responsible for the ongoing development and evolution of Vanguard Anti-Cheat’s Windows client services. You’ll set technical direction, shape priorities, and ensure the team delivers secure, reliable capabilities across Vanguard’s Anti-Cheat suite in a timely manner. While your primary focus will be enabling the team and driving outcomes, your strong fluency in cheat communities and techniques will allow you to guide architecture, challenge technical decisions, and step directly into complex debugging or investigations when needed. You’ll help the team anticipate and analyze emerging cheat techniques, then translate those findings into effective detections, mitigations, and preventative controls. You will report directly to the Sr. Manager of Anti-Cheat Engineering.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage, identify, recruit, interview, and hire engineers to help the team scale effectively
  • Set direction and drive high-impact anti-cheat capabilities from ambiguity through production across user-mode, kernel-mode, and obfuscation tooling surfaces
  • Lead the team in rapidly translating emerging threats into resilient detections and preventative countermeasures that can be safely deployed at scale
  • Balance immediate threat response with proactive technical investments that anticipate adversaries’ next moves or eliminate common abuse vectors entirely
  • Guide and participate in complex investigations involving highly evasive cheats and operating-system manipulation techniques
  • Ensure the team can diagnose and resolve complex compatibility, reliability, and security issues in highly opaque environments, stepping into the details when needed
  • Build trusted relationships with game teams as internal customers, helping them understand their cheating ecosystems, integrate Anti-Cheat effectively, and make informed tradeoffs across security, player experience, scope, and delivery
  • Establish clear priorities and technical expectations, helping engineers navigate uncertainty and make sound decisions across security, compatibility, performance, and operational risk
  • Partner across engineering, product, operations, and game teams to align dependencies, communicate risk, and deliver anti-cheat capabilities successfully across Riot’s portfolio

jobs.title: Senior VFX Artist - Unpublished R&D Product
jobs.description:
As part of the Real-Time VFX team, you’ll design and help implement the sleek, dynamic and dramatic special effects that add atmosphere and depth to gameplay. With your experience, you’ll create aesthetically astounding visual effects that communicate essential game information. You’ll use your artistic and technical skills to breathe life into undead spells, channel primal emotions and capture the essence of hundreds of champions.

As a Senior VFX Artist on the Riot Discovery Studio (RDS) team, you will report to the Sr. VFX Manager and play a key role on a small VFX team delivering high-spectacle gameplay experiences. Under the direction of the VFX Lead, you will use your creative and technical expertise to design, execute, and implement a wide range of gameplay and environmental visual effects. You’ll partner closely with VFX, Design, and other disciplines to establish best practices, champion visual quality and gameplay clarity, and translate your expertise into scalable solutions as the team transitions into production. Beyond asset creation, you will help strengthen the VFX discipline by sharing craft expertise, leading discipline initiatives, and serving as a bridge between VFX and cross-functional partners. You will also support team leadership with operational and discipline-development efforts that help the team work effectively and sustainably. RDS operates in a highly iterative environment, so you’ll need to navigate ambiguity and respond thoughtfully to frequent shifts in content, creative direction, and priorities. As the team continues to define its VFX direction and production practices, your work and expertise will directly influence the quality bar and help establish what great VFX looks like for the product.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and deliver polished, dynamic visual effects that enhance atmosphere, depth, and gameplay while aligning with the project’s creative and stylistic goals.
  • Balance visual impact with gameplay clarity, ensuring effects accurately communicate actions, states, and player-facing information.
  • Autonomously create high-quality VFX by applying a broad range of craft skills, including painting, drawing, animation, and modeling as needed.
  • Establish and apply VFX best practices and scalable solutions, such as VFX theme kits, that support a broad range of production and product goals.
  • Represent the VFX discipline across cross-functional teams, providing subject matter expertise and advocating for the needs, capabilities, and opportunities of visual effects to have maximum player impact.
  • Uphold VFX craft quality standards through mentorship, constructive feedback, documentation, and accountability within the discipline.
  • Collaborate closely and proactively with VFX teammates, balancing complementary expertise and contributing to the ongoing development of the team and discipline.

jobs.title: Principal Visual Design Artist - Unpublished R&D Product
jobs.description:

Designers collaborate with cross disciplinary teams and act as both artistic and design problem solvers. They understand players and ask questions about the what, who, and how when solving for an interface or communication challenge.

We need your help to produce assets of the highest quality so our players can immerse themselves in our world. You'll report to the Visual Design Lead and collaborate with other artists to establish the style of the game's user interface.   • Create visually balanced and intuitive interfaces that show an excellent grasp of readability, hierarchy, platform and player behavior patterns

  • Create assets through each stage of development, taking ideas from concept to in-game implementation
  • Use deep knowledge of systemic design, graphic design, interactivity, layout, typography, color theory, and illustration to create seamless player experience
  • Extend themes throughout the project, establishing style guides and conventions
  • Establish the quality bar for visual design for the game

  • Hands-on experience contributing to a major feature, game, product launch, or entertainment property through the craft of visual communication design.

  • Expert knowledge in Figma & Adobe CC
  • Knowledge of the game development pipeline including optimization, localization and implementation
  • Experience shipping games in Unreal, Unity, or any relevant game engine.
  • Portfolio that demonstrates visual taste of contemporary graphic design and strong artistic style

  • Experience developing brand identities, logos, brand kits, etc.
  • Experience in a secondary area such as motion graphics, illustration, animation, or modeling

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

  • Build instrumentation libraries, SDKs, and eBPF-based auto-instrumentation to emit high-quality telemetry, with and without code changes
  • Reduce mean time to detection and resolution by building cross-signal correlation (from kernel-level events up to application traces), unified query interfaces, and AI-assisted diagnostic tooling
  • Improve fleet-wide efficiency by turning continuous profiling and utilization telemetry into actionable optimization insights across CPU, memory, and accelerator fleets

jobs.title: Senior Anti-Cheat Engineer - Central Technology, Anti-Cheat
jobs.description:
Riot Anti-Cheat Engineers are versatile and passionate about their craft. We understand the player impact of cheating in games and are focused on setting the highest bar for the integrity of multiplayer games. We relish the opportunity to work with low-level systems and take pride in developing creative, rigorous defenses against adversaries. At the most fundamental level, our goal is to promote the best player experience by protecting the legitimacy of their favorite games.

As a Senior Anti-Cheat Engineer, you will be responsible for the ongoing development and evolution of Vanguard Anti-Cheat’s client services. With versatility across user-mode, kernel-mode, and obfuscation tooling services, you’ll work primarily in C/C++ and x86/x64 assembly to build new anti-cheat features, improve the security and reliability of existing systems, and debug complex behavior across the Windows stack. You’ll also reverse engineer emerging cheats, including packed and obfuscated binaries, and rapidly translate those findings into practical detections, mitigations, and preventative controls. You'll be based in our Santa Monica, CA office and work in a hybrid (work-from-home and in-office) environment. You'll report to the Sr. Manager of Anti-Cheat Engineering.

Responsibilities:

  • Identify and drive high impact anti-cheat features from ambiguity to production across user-mode, kernel-mode, and obfuscation tooling surfaces
  • Move fast to turn emerging threats into resilient detections or preventative countermeasures that can be safely deployed with agility at scale.
  • Think ahead to design and develop capabilities that anticipate the cheaters next move or eliminate common abuse vectors entirely
  • Reverse engineer highly evasive cheats and operating system manipulation techniques
  • Investigate and resolve complex compatibility issues in highly opaque environments
  • Support game teams directly in understanding cheating ecosystems and integrating Anti-Cheat

Required Qualifications:

  • Proficient in C/C++ and x86/x64 assembly
  • Experience building and debugging low-level, security-sensitive systems
  • Strong understanding of Windows process internals, including process and thread lifecycles, virtual memory, handles and objects, security contexts, executable image formats, DLL loading, and the Windows loader
  • Hands-on reverse engineering experience, including analyzing packed, protected, or obfuscated binaries and identifying techniques used to conceal or manipulate runtime behavior
  • Practical understanding of the Windows kernel and driver model, with demonstrated experience developing, debugging, and maintaining production grade kernel-mode drivers.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Hands-on experience within cheat-development or game-security research communities, with practical knowledge of modern cheat techniques

  • 负责高优先级引擎动画效果的技术方案设计与落地，包括动画状态机、IK、角色物理及相关动画技术能力建设

  • 开发和推动面向动画制作与效率工具、调试流程方案，帮助团队更高质量、更高效率地完成内容实现

能力要求

  • 6 年及以上游戏或相关行业技术美术经验，并在技术动画方向有扎实的实操经验
  • 具备从效果目标出发，进行技术抽象与方案判断的能力，能够在动画表现、玩法需求、实现成本与长期可维护性之间做出合理权衡
  • 具备扎实的 Unreal Engine 经验，熟悉蓝图、动画状态机、IK 工作流、角色物理、镜头相关等实现
  • 熟悉 Maya 绑定工作流程与相关功能使用，理解角色绑定与动画系统的基础实现逻辑
  • 优秀的跨职能沟通与协作能力

优先条件

  • 有主导角色绑定系统开发的经验，或具备基于 Maya 的 Python 脚本开发能力

  • 有影视叙事、表演类高规格角色制作流程的相关经验

For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes the delight of players. We will be looking at your past studies, experience, and your personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about players' experiences, this could be your role!

作为一名3D特效设计师（Contract），你将加入拳头，参与项目研发阶段的特效制作工作。

你将基于既定美术风格与表现方向，负责游戏内战斗与系统特效的制作与实现，与美术、动画、TA及客户端团队紧密协作，确保特效效果与性能表现达到项目要求。该岗位更侧重实际制作能力、引擎实现能力与性能控制能力，适合具备成熟产出经验的特效设计师。

jobs.title: 中国区周边消费品业务销售运营经理 (Contract)
jobs.description:
拳头游戏（Riot Games）由一群富有创业精神的硬核玩家于2006年创立。我们坚信“玩家优先”的理念能够造就伟大的游戏。我们的首款游戏《英雄联盟》（League of Legends）于2009年发行，赢得了业界与玩家的广泛赞誉。如今，它已成为全球最受欢迎的电子游戏之一，月活跃玩家超过一亿。

在拳头游戏，玩家是我们一切工作的核心。我们正在寻找谦逊、充满雄心且目光敏锐的专业人才，你们不仅要对游戏满怀热情，还要敢于打破常规。作为回报，我们将为你提供充满挑战且全力支持的成长环境。

关于该职位 作为业务运营经理，你将直接向消费品业务运营负责人汇报，并成为我们在B2B商业版图上的核心驱动力。你将扮演至关重要的桥梁角色，将拳头游戏的高品质IP周边与我们的战略线下及B2B合作伙伴紧密连接。

你的核心使命主要分为三个方面：积极拓展B2B网络，获取全新的大客户；深入管理并发展现有的战略合作关系；全盘负责我们线下体验式零售活动的商业闭环（如电竞快闪店和粉丝嘉年华）。你是一位谈判专家和关系建立大师，深知在游戏IP领域，成功的B2B战略绝不仅仅是单纯的“卖货”，而是在现实世界中为我们的玩家创造触手可及、高品质的体验触点。

核心职责

  • 大客户拓展（B2B商务拓展）： 发掘、宣讲并引入新的战略级B2B合作伙伴、线下零售连锁店及垂直领域经销商。开拓与拳头游戏高端品牌定位相符的全新线下销售渠道。
  • 现有KA覆盖与增长： 维护并深化与现有大客户（如腾讯、大型线下零售网络）的合作关系。负责商业条款谈判、管控批发利润率，并确保健康的库存消化率，从而达成年度B2B营收目标。
  • 线下活动与体验式零售： 主导线下周边体验的端到端商业落地。包括在LPL总决赛、VCT巡回赛、拳头游戏周年庆及专属快闪店等重大节点中，全面管理现场销售运营、库存把控及合作伙伴协调。
  • B2B战略与规划： 与销售运营负责人紧密合作，制定年度和季度的B2B销售策略，确保其与我们更广泛的DTP（玩家直营）/电商目标相辅相成。
  • 合作伙伴营销与联合推广： 与外部KA伙伴及内部营销团队协同，设计定制化的零售营销活动，确保我们的实体产品在合作伙伴的生态系统中获得最大化的曝光。
  • 数据追踪与汇报： 监控B2B渠道健康度、合作伙伴合规性以及线下活动的投资回报率（ROI）。提供定期的销售预测与具备实操性的洞察分析，以持续优化线下业务。

任职要求

  • 本科及以上学历。
  • 8年以上B2B销售、大客户管理或渠道商务拓展经验；拥有消费品、潮玩或娱乐IP行业经验者优先。
  • 扎实的BD业绩： 能够证明自己具备开拓新市场、谈判复杂分销合同，以及从零搭建盈利性B2B渠道的能力。
  • 线下活动运营： 具备线下零售运营、快闪店或大型活动/展会商业展台操盘的实战经验。
  • 利益相关方管理： 出色的跨部门/跨企业沟通技巧，能够影响并管理顶级经销商以及内部跨职能团队（如供应链、营销、IP授权等）。
  • 敏捷性与问题解决能力： 适应快节奏的工作环境，乐于挽起袖子亲力亲为，能够迅速解决线下活动现场的突发运营问题。
  • 沟通能力： 具备出色的中英文口头与书面沟通及商业谈判能力。

加分项（期待条件）

  • 在中国核心的线下潮玩/收藏品零售商、书店、院线或生活方式分销网络中拥有深厚的人脉资源与现有合作关系。
  • 对游戏充满真挚的热爱，并对《英雄联盟》、《无畏契约》（VALORANT）或《云顶之弈》（TFT）的玩家文化有深刻理解。

在这个岗位上，你的成功将源于精湛的专业技能、团队协作精神，以及始终将“给玩家带来惊喜”置于首位的决策力。我们不仅会考量你的过往学业与经验，还会看重你与游戏的个人羁绊。如果你具备玩家同理心，并深切关怀玩家的体验，这就是为你量身定制的角色！

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - AI Compute, Together Cloud
jobs.description:
About the Role

Together AI is building the AI Native Cloud, an end-to-end platform for the full generative AI lifecycle, combining the fastest LLM inference engine with state-of-the-art GPU cloud infrastructure. The Together Cloud team builds the [Together GPU Clusters](https://www.together.ai/gpu-clusters) flagship IaaS product that provides high-performance, AI-ready GPU clusters through a self-serve cloud console, along with the virtualized infrastructure layer powering Together's inference, RL, and fine-tuning products.

As a Senior Software Engineer focusing on AI Compute in the Together Cloud org, you will build and own major components of the next generation AI cloud platform – a highly available, global cloud infrastructure with cutting-edge virtualization of the latest ML hardware: GB300s/VRs, BlueField DPUs, InfiniBand and dual/quad-plane RoCEv2 fabrics. That virtualized computing platform powers our own SaaS products – inference, RL, and fine-tuning – and serves external cloud customers through self-serve offerings such as on-demand/reserved Kubernetes/Slurm clusters, across dozens of data centers and hundreds of thousands of GPUs.

The hard problems in rapidly scaling heterogeneous GPU fleets are software problems: fully automated bootstrapping of GPU data centers, high-performance virtualization of GPU compute and DC networking without compromising isolation or portability, and fault-tolerant decentralized control planes. We solve them by building global and in-DC services, Kubernetes operators, and high-performance SDN libraries, forking hypervisors and Linux kernels, and building infra tailored to inference and fine-tuning. You'll own massive greenfield projects across their full lifecycle – scoping the problem and writing PRDs with our PMs, designing the system, and building it through to GA launch.

Responsibilities

  • Build the GPU and network virtualization stack: the hypervisor, kernel, and SDN work that makes GPU compute and DC networking high-performance, portable, and strongly isolated across heterogeneous hardware.
  • Build and maintain our in-DC IaaS layer: the services, Kubernetes operators, and libraries that provision and manage compute, storage, and networks in our data centers, including VMs, parallel filesystems, VPCs, and InfiniBand partitions. Implement and harden the bring-up path for a new Vera Rubin data center with thousands of GPUs.
  • Scale the distributed GPU scheduling and global management plane: the control-plane services behind on-demand and reserved clusters, including the automation that onboards new capacity and raises per-cluster limits.
  • Harden the monitoring and automated remediation layer for fault tolerance: automated detection, isolation, and recovery of failed nodes that keeps distributed pretraining and large-scale inference fault-tolerant.

jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

PROGRAMMING - UNREAL ENGINE

What We Do

Unreal-powered projects have been on the bleeding edge of real-time entertainment for over 20 years. Our team of programming experts are always innovating to improve the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

We're looking for a Senior Tools Programmer to evolve artist tools within the Unreal Editor, particularly in geometry and texturing processing, terrain authoring, and procedural generation. An important aspect of this role is supporting both user-driven and agentic workflows, including exploring and implementing new interaction paradigms to accelerate content creation. You'll directly impact artist productivity by developing user-facing tools for one of the leading game engines used by developers worldwide.

In this role, you will

  • Support and extend existing artist tools for internal and external users
  • Refactor existing tools to be more accessible and effective for agentic workflows
  • Create new tools at the intersection of user-driven and agent-driven content creation

jobs.description:
Location: Hybrid, Zürich (2-3 days in office)

About what. AG

We're a Zurich-based digital consultancy with 40+ ambitious, kind specialists. We build websites, digital products and growth strategies powered by data and AI, for clients from innovative startups to global brands. Learn more at

what.digital

.

The role:

You take a business-first, data-driven view of what's holding a client's growth back, use AI to diagnose it faster and deeper than a traditional audit, and turn it into a concrete plan that works. It's a long-term role with variety, autonomy, support and a clear path to grow.

How we work:

You own your growth, and we give you the space to work on yourself. We deliver first-class help to our clients, from start to finish. We focus on real results, not just activity. And we think like entrepreneurs: when we build for clients, everyone wins - our clients, what. and you.

What you'll do:

Be the main point of contact for your clients and build long-term relationships - you think about their business, not just their campaigns.

Implement growth strategies across SEO/GEO, paid ads, email, social and more, using AI with the team.

Coordinate specialists to deliver great work on time and on budget, with high standards and honest feedback.

Run data and AI-assisted analyses to find growth opportunities and turn them into business cases and new projects.

Keep an eye on budgets and billing, with support from our finance team.

Optional: lead the specialist team, including team happiness and recruiting.

Key & Essential Skills:

Ideally 7+ years in a performance agency (not media buying), including 3+ years leading a team of 3+.

Deep knowledge of at least 3 marketing channels (e.g. SEO, Google Ads, Meta, content), with CHF 1M+ in total managed budget.

Proven record in client strategy, sales and building data-driven business cases that clients invest in.

Native-level German, understanding of Swiss German, fluent English.

Comfortable using AI as a core tool for analysis, reporting and consulting.

What makes you a fit:

You like taking ownership and seeing things through.

You give honest feedback, to clients and to us.

You know when to plan carefully, when to perfect, and when to move fast.

You think like an entrepreneur: curious, commercially minded, always moving forward.

Perks:

Beautiful office in Seefeld, Zurich.

You'll have real responsibility and influence - and a team that has your back. If you see something that could be improved, speak up - we're listening.

Flexible hours and a flat hierarchy - we're results-oriented and don't micromanage.

A multicultural team that learns together, including daily hands-on work with AI tools like Claude.

25 days holiday plus public holidays.

Fair compensation and profit participation.

Personal development opportunities, e.g. in 2026 we sent 10 people to Tony Robbins' UPW event.

Apply via our website with your CV and a 2-3 min intro video in German (e.g. Loom or YouTube)

In this role you will create and execute communications plans around high stakes policy, legal and regulatory developments, that impact Epic and the video game industry at large.

jobs.title: Staff + Software Security Engineer, Labs
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Frontier AI is on track to be among the most consequential and most adversarially-targeted technology in the world. The capability curve is steep, the adversaries who want these systems are extremely well-resourced, and the security bar this will eventually require is well beyond where the industry operates today. Incremental hardening alone is not going to close that gap, so we need breakthroughs and a group of people to go find them.

Security Labs is that team. We run a portfolio of high-risk, high-expected-value security projects: the work that seems impractical until someone optimistic and stubborn enough actually tries it. Projects run on the order of weeks rather than quarters, and each one is either handed off to the Anthropic team that will own it in production or wound down with a writeup of what we learned. We expect a meaningful fraction of our bets not to land.

This team is intentionally scrappy and ambitious. We're intentionally iterating fast on high-risk research bets and we expect a meaningful fraction not to land. If a 30% project success rate sounds uncomfortable, or uncharted and chaotic territory isn’t both frightening and exciting, this probably isn't the right fit. There are other places in Anthropic Security doing important work with more structure, less risk, and more certain paths to positive outcomes.

The questions we're trying to answer include:

  • Can our core research workflows survive extreme isolation?
  • Can we replace trust with cryptographic guarantees?
  • Can the models themselves become our most effective security control?
  • What would it actually take to defend against a tier-1 state adversary, and how much of that can we build now?

Who we're looking for. We're hiring generalists with rare depth. You're a strong software engineer as a baseline, and on top of that you've gone deep in at least one area most engineers don't get near: firmware or hardware security, applied cryptography, OS / kernel / hypervisor internals, formal methods, reverse engineering, or high-assurance and cross-domain systems. You've built things under your own direction, you're comfortable jumping layers when the problem demands it, and you'd rather take a swing at something that might not work than ship the safe incremental thing. jobs.title: Head of Hardware
jobs.description:
Accelerating embodied AGI.

The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century.  MicroAGI is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab.  Atlas  captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line.  Shift  records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data.  We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries.  Our models learn from data captured in the physical world, by hardware we design and build ourselves. As Head of Hardware, you own that hardware end to end: electrical, firmware, and the mechanical integration that holds it together, from the first schematic to devices running on factory floors.  You lead the team that builds it. Today that is about six engineers on robotics, three on EMG sensing, and three on camera systems, plus contractors, and it will grow quickly. Our Electrical Engineer and Embedded Engineer roles report to you. You set the architecture they build against, and you still build alongside them.  This is a founder-shaped role, not a management seat. We are looking for someone who has carried a product from a blank page to customers with real skin in the game, wants to build both the thing and the team that builds it, and would rather design than review. If that sounds like you, you will want to do it again at the earliest stage.

What You Will Do

Own the hardware roadmap for Shift and Atlas data capture: wearables, sensor rigs, camera systems, and prototype robots. What we build, in what order, and why.

Set the system architecture across electrical, firmware, and mechanical: sensors, compute, power, wireless, and enclosures. Make the trade-offs, and make them stick when disciplines disagree.

Stay on the bench: schematics, layout reviews, board bring-up, and a scope in your hands when the team is stuck. On the days it matters, you are the best electrical engineer in the room.

Lead and grow the team: hire, set the bar, run design reviews, and give engineers ownership of whole subsystems rather than tickets.

Guarantee data quality end to end: EMG and EEG front ends, camera pipelines, IMUs, and synchronization across many devices, so that what reaches the ML team is clean, time-aligned, and trustworthy.

Take designs from prototype to small-batch production: DFM, component and E
